Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 15:
Haomer veladah shel zo ola vihi shelamim devarav kayyamim. hi shelamim uveladah ola. im lechach nitkavven devarav kayyamim. veim achar sheggamar belibbo vehotzi bisfatav shettihye shelamim chazar bo veamar uveladah ola. af al pi shechazar bo betoch kede dibbur hare veladah shelamim. sheen chazara behekdesh vaafillu betoch kede dibbur:
Haomer yadah shel zo ola o raglah shel zo ola timmacher lechayyave olot vedameha chullin chutz middeme oto evar. vehu sheyyihye ze hamechuyyav ola shekkana otah nadar ola bedamim ketzuvim. haomer libbah o roshah shel zo ola. hoil vedavar shehanneshama teluya bo hu kullah ola. hikdish evar echad min haof hare ze safek im nitkaddesh kullo o lo nitkaddesh:
Haomer behema zo chetzyah ola vechetzyah shelamim kadsha. veenah kereva ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bachatzi dameha ola uvachatzi dameha shelamim. haya mechuyyav chattat veamar chetzyah chattat vechetzyah ola o shelamim. o sheamar chetzyah ola o shelamim vechetzyah chattat. hare hi tamut kemo sheyyitbaer bachattaot hammetot:
Behemat hashshuttafin shehikdish echad mehen chetzyah shello vechazar velakach chetzyah haacher vehikdisho hare zo kedesha ukereva. af al pi shemmittechillatah dechuya hayta keshehikdish chetzyah en haddachuy meikkaro dachuy veaf al pi shehu kedushshat damim hoil vehi baale chayyim en baale chayyim niddachim. vahare niret kullah lehakerava lefichach tikkarev veosa temura:
Haomer deme behema zo ola o hare zo leola. im hayta reuya likkarev ola nitkaddesha kedushshat hagguf vehi atzmah tikkarev ola. veim enah reuya timmacher veyavi bedameha ola:
Amar al behema temea vechayyotze bah meissure karban sheen kedushsha chala alehen hare ellu ola lo amar kelum kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach. amar hare ellu leola yimmachru veyavi bidmehen ola:
Haomer deme para zo leola kol sheloshim yom uleachar sheloshim yom lishlamim o sheamar dameha lishlamim kol sheloshim yom uleachar sheloshim yom leola devarav kayyamim. veim hikriv dameha betoch sheloshim yom mevi bahen kemo shennadar veim hikrivo leachar sheloshim yom mevi kemo shennadar:
Hayta lo behema meubberet veamar im teled zachar hare hu ola veim hi nekeva zivche shelamim. yalda zachar yikkarev ola. yalda nekeva tikkarev zivche shelamim. yalda zachar unekeva hazzachar yikkarev ola vehannekeva zivche shelamim. yalda shene zecharim echad yikkarev ola vehashsheni yimmacher letzarche ola vedamav chullin. vechen im yalda shete nekevot achat tikkarev shelamim usheniyya timmacher letzarche shelamim vedameha chullin. yalda tumtum veanderoginus enan kadashim vahare hen chullin kemo shebbearnu. vehammakdish ubbar bime baalat mum vechayyotze bah hare ze kadosh:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 16:
Hannoder gadol vehevi katan lo yatza. katan vehevi gadol yatza. ketzad. amar hare alay ola o shelamim keves vehevi ayil. o shennadar egel vehevi shor. gedi vehevi sair yatza:
Nadar ola min hakkevasim o min haelim vehevi pilgas hare ze safek im yatza yede nidro o lo yatza. vechen hannoder olat of min hattorim o min bene hayyona vehevi techillat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze hare ze safek. nadar shachor vehevi lavan lavan vehevi shachor zachar vehevi nekeva nekeva vehevi zachar lo yatza:
Hannoder setam mevi min haggedolim shebbammin shennadar. veim oto hammakom regilin likrot bistam leechad min hamminin mevi keanshe hammakom. ketzad. nadar ola min habbakar yavi shor. amar hare alay ola im derech anshe hammakom likrot ola setam afillu leolat haof mevi pereda achat tor o ben yona. veim darkan sheen korin ola setam ella leolat bakar yavi shor. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mi shennadar shor o ayil o keves o egel vechayyotze bahem lo yavi kachush beyoter shebbeoto hammin mippene sheddamav muatin. veeno chayyav lehavi hayyafe hashshamen beyoter sheen sham lemala mimmennu ella yavi habbenoni. veim hevi hakkachush yatza yede nidro:
Haomer hare alay shor sheve mane yavi shor sheshshave mane beoto makom chutz minnesachav. hevi shenayim bemane lo yatza:
Haomer shor ze ola venafal bo mum im ratza yavi bedamav shenayim vaafillu hevi bedamav ayil echad yatza. amar shene shevarim ellu ola venafal bahem mum im ratza yavi bidmehem echad. ayil ze ola venafal bo mum im ratza yavi bedamav keves. vechen im nadar keves venifsal im ratza yavi bedamav ayil:
Amar hare alay ola vehifrish shor venignav poter atzmo bese. amar shor ze vedamav alay ola hukba veim nifsal lo yavi bedamav ella shor:
Haomer echad mikkevasay hekdesh veechad mishshevaray hekdesh vehayu lo shenayim haggadol shebbahen hekdesh. hayu shelosha haggadol shebbahen hekdesh vechoshshin labbenoni. ketzad yaase. yamtin labbenoni ad sheyyippol bo mum vetachul hakkedushsha al haggadol levaddo. veim amar shor shebbishvaray hekdesh haggadol shebbahem hekdesh veen choshshin labbenoni:
Perash echad mehen veshachach o sheamar lo aviv echad mehen hekdesh hare ze makdish gadol shebbahen veachar kach yetze yede chovato. vechen hannoder ola min habbakar vekava nidro veshachach ma kava im shor im egel hare ze yavi shor. vechen im kava bakkevasim veshachach ma kava yavi ayil. kava baizzim veshachach yavi sair. shachach beeze min min habbehema kava olato yavi shor veayil vesair. veim nistappek lo shemma kava olato baof yosif tor uven yona:
Nadar toda o shelamim vekava nidro babbakar veshachach bemi kevao yavi par ufara. vechen im nistappek lo bakkevasim yavi ayil verachel. nistappek lo baizzim yavi sair useira. shachach bee ze min kava nidro mevi par ufara ayil verachel sair useira. haomer hare alay olat of mevi tor o ben yona. peresh veshachach bee ze min kava nidro mevi tor uven yona:
Haomer hare alay lammizbeach yavi kometz levona sheen lecha davar shekkarev kullo lammizbeach kemot shehu ella levona. peresh nidro veshachach ma peresh yavi mikkol davar shekkarev kullo lammizbeach. lefichach mevi olat behema veolat haof uminchat nesachim ulevona veyayin bifne atzmo:
Amar hare alay besela lammizbeach yavi keves. sheen lecha davar shekkarev besela lammizbeach ella keves. peresh veshachach ma shepperesh yavi besela mikkol davar vedavar shekkarev lammizbeach:
Haomer hare alay levona lo yifchot mikkometz. hare alay etzim lo yifchot mishshene gezarim avin kimchukot vearkan amma. hare alay etz mevi gezer echad arko amma. veim ratza lehavi deme haetzim yavi:
Mi shennadar o hitnaddev shemen ketzad osin bo. kometz mimmennu kometz venoten alav melach vezorko al gabbe haishshim vehashshear neechol lakkohanim kishyare menachot. vechetzad osin beyayin habba bifne atzmo. noten alav melach umenassecho kullo al gabbe hashshitin kechol hannesachim. vehallevona habbaa bifne atzmah noten aleha melach vechullah laishshim:
Mi shennadar neder lo yeviennu mimmeot maaser sheni shehare nitchayyev bekarban ze vechol hamechuyyav bekarban lo yavi karbano ella min hachullin:
Amar hare alay toda min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser lo yavi lachmah ella min hachullin. shehare nadar bekarban toda vehattoda enah baa ella im hallechem min hachullin:
Peresh veamar hare alay lehavi toda mimmeot maaser sheni velachmah min hachullin yesh lo lehavi kemo shennadar. veim hevi hakkol min hachullin yatza. vechen im peresh veamar hare alay toda hi velachmah min hammaaser yavi. velo yavi lachmah mechitte maaser sheni ella mimmeot maaser sheni kemo habbehema shehi mimmeot maaser sheni. veaf al pi shepperesh sheyyavi lachmah min hammaaser lo yavi nesacheha mimmeot maaser sheni sheen hannesachim bain leolam ella min hachullin kemo shebbearnu. lefi shenneemar bahen <small>(Bamidbar 15 4)</small> "vehikriv hammakriv karbano" ad sheyyihyu mishshello velo yihye bahen tzad legavoah kelal:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 17: Hannoder mincha maafe tannur lo yavi moafe kuppach velo maafe reafim velo maafe yorot haarviyyim:

Haomer hare alay bemachavat vehevi bemarcheshet. bemarcheshet vehevi bemachavat. ma shehevi hevi vide chovato lo yatza. veim amar zo lehavi bemarcheshet veheviah bemachavat. o bemachavat veheviah bemarcheshet. hare zo pesula. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen haomer hare alay shene esronot lahavian bichli echad vehevian bishne kelim. bishne kelim vehevian bichli echad. ma shehevi hevi vide chovato lo yatza. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 24)</small> "kaasher nadarta laAdonai":

Amar ellu lehavi bichli echad vehevi bishne kelim o lehavi bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad hare ellu pesulin. lo kevaan bishat hanneder ella amar hare alay shene esronot uvishat haferasha kevaan vehifrishan bishne kelim vechazar vehevian bichli echad hare ellu kesherim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 24)</small> "kaasher nadarta" velo kaasher hifrashta. amar hare alay shene esronot lehavi bichli echad vehevian bishne kelim. amru lo bichli echad nadarta. hikrivam bishne kelim hare ellu pesulin. hikrivam bichli echad hare ellu kesherim:

Amar hare alay shene esronot lehavi bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad. amru lo bishne kelim nadarta. hikrivan bishne kelim hare ellu kesherim. hikrivan bichli echad hare ellu kishte menachot shennitarvu:

Homer hare alay mincha. yavi achat mechameshet mine menachot habbaot beneder unedava. amar hare alay menachot yavi shene (mine) menachot mechamishtan. amar hare alay min menachot yavi shene menachot mimmin echad. hare alay mine menachot yavi shete menachot mishshene minim. vechen im amar mine mincha yavi shene minin. kava nidro bemin mehen ushechacho mevi chamishshetan:

En hayyachid mevi mincha bichli echad yoter mishshishshim issaron. veim nadar yoter mishshishshim mevi shishshim bichli echad vehashshear bichli sheni. sheen yecholin lehibbalel keechad ella shishshim aval yeter al shishshim en nivlalin. af al pi sheen habbelila meakkevet kemo shebbearnu amru chachamim kol harauy levila en habbila meakkevet bo vechol sheeno rauy levila habbila meakkevet bo:

Amar hare alay mea veesrim veechad issaron mevi mea veesrim bishne kelim shishshim bechol keli umevi issaron echad bakkeli hashshelishi. amar hare alay issaron yavi issaron echad. hare alay esronot yavi shenayim. peresh nidro veshachach kamma issaron peresh yavi shishshim issaron bichli echad. shachach kamma issaron peresh uvee ze min kevao. hare ze mevi shishshim issaron mikkol min vamin mechamishtan:

Kava nidro veshachach kamma esronot nadar uvechamma kelim nadar hare ze mevi meechad vead shishshim beshishshim kelim. ketzad. mevi issaron echad bichli rishon ushene esronim bichli sheni ushelosha esronim bashshelishi ad sheyyihyu ad shishshim issaron bakkeli haacharon. veim shachach af bee ze min kava mevi al seder ze shishshim kelim mikkol min venimtza mevi mikkol min elef ushemone meot usheloshim issaron:

Haomer hare alay minchat seorim o minchat chatzi issaron o minchat belo shemen ulevona hare ze patur. shello hitnaddev davar shekkamohu makrivin. amar hare alay mincha min hasseorim o min haadashim o mincha belo shemen ulevona o mincha chatzi issaron. shoalin oto im amar lo nadarti ella al daat shemmuttar lehakeriv kaze veillu yadati sheen makrivin ella issaron shalem solet beshemen ulevona lo hayiti noder hare ze patur. veim amar illu hayiti yodea hayiti noder kederech shemmakrivin hare ze chayyav lehakeriv kederech shemmakrivin:

Nadar issaron umechetza veamar illu hayiti yodea hayiti noder kederech hammitnaddevin hare ze mevi shenayim. amar hare alay kemach o hare alay chatzi issaron velo hizkir shem mincha hare ze patur kemi shello nadar meolam. vechen haomer hare alay toda belo lechem vezevach belo nesachim hare ze patur. veim amar illu hayiti yodea sheen makrivin kach hayiti noder kederech hannodrin hare ze chayyav lehakeriv kederech hammakrivin:

Haomer hare alay lachme toda yavi toda velachmah. shehaddavar yadua sheen makrivin lechem belo toda vesof hakkarban hizkir. amar hare alay lechem liftor todato shel peloni yavi lechem toda im todat chavero:

Mitnaddev o noder adam yayin bifne atzmo. veen mitnaddevin log yayin velo shene login. sheen binsachim lo log velo shenayim. veen mitnaddevin chamishsha sheen chameshet login reuyin lo leniske behema achat velo leniske shete behemot. aval mitnaddevin shelosha vearbaa veshishsha umishshishsha vamala mippene shehen reuyin leniske behemot:

Ketzad. nadar shiva hare hen keniske keves veayil. nadar shemona hare ellu keniske shene elim. tisha keniske shor vecheves o keniske shelosha kevasim. nadar asara hare ellu keniske shor veayil o shene kevasim veayil vechen ad leolam:

Nadar chamishsha login omrin lo hashelem shishsha shehare kevaan lekarban. aval im nadar log o shenayim patur shehare enan reuyin kelal lo hen velo miktzatan. veen mitnaddevin velo nodrin pachot millog shemen. sheen lecha mincha pechuta meissaron vehi tzericha log echad shemen:

Haomer hare alay yayin lo yifchot mishshelosha login. hare alay shemen lo yifchot millog. peresh nidro veshachach kamma log nadar min hayyayin o min hashshemen yavi arbaim umea log. sheen lecha yom shemmakrivin bo hatztzibbur karbanot merubbot yoter miyyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat vehayu hannesachim bo mea vearbaim log shemen uchemotam yayin kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot temidin umusafin:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 18: Kol hakkarbanot kullan ben karbenot behema veof ben karbenot menachot mitzvat ase lehakerivan bevet habbechira shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 14)</small> "vesham taase kol asher anochi metzavvekka". vechen mitzvat ase lihyot kol adam metappel umevi karbenot behema shennitchayyev lehakerivan michutza laaretz levet habbechira shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 26)</small> "kadashecha asher yihyu lecha unedarecha tissa" vegomer. mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno medabber ella bekadshe chutza laaretz shehu metappel bahem ad sheyyeviem levet habbechira:

Hammakriv karban chutz laazara bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 13)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha bechol makom asher tire". veim hikriv bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "asher yaale ola o zavach" <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio" "venichrat meammav". beshogeg mevi chattat kevua:

Vechen hashshochet kadashim chutz laazara af al pi shello heelam im haya mezid chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 3)</small> "asher yishchat shor o chesev o ez" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 4)</small> "dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach venichrat". veim shachat beshogeg mevi chattat kevua:

Vehechan hizhir al hashshechita bachutz. behekkesh. neemar <small>(Devarim 12 14)</small> "sham taale olotecha" veneemar <small>(Devarim 12 14)</small> "vesham taase kol asher anochi metzavvekka". ma haaliyya bachutz sheanash aleha hizhir aleha beferush shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 13)</small> "hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha". af asiyya shebbichlal hashshechita sheanash aleha beferush hare hu muzhar aleha. shello anash hakkatuv ella im ken hizhir:

Hashshochet kadashim veheelam bachutz chayyav shetayim. achat al hashshechita veachat al haaliyya. shachat bifnim veheela bachutz chayyav al haaliyya. vechen im shachat bachutz veheela bifnim chayyav al hashshechita:

Eno chayyav ella al shechitat kadashim haruyin likkarev legabbe mizbeach. aval hashshochet bachutz echad meissure mizbeach o mechattaot hammetot hare ze patur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 4)</small> "lifne mishkan Adonai" vechol sheeno rauy lavo el mishkan Adonai en chayyavin alav:
Shachat bachutz mechussar zeman begufo o babbealim hoil veeno rauy atta lavo bifnim patur:
E zehu mechussar zeman begufo. behema betoch shivat yeme halleda. vetorin shello higgia zemannan. veoto veet beno shennishchat echad mehem hayyom sheen hashsheni rauy ad lemachar:

Vee zehu mechussar zeman babbealim. karban sheadayin lo higgia zeman bealav lehakerivo. ketzad. hazzav vehazzava vehayyoledet sheshshachatu chattatam bachutz [betoch] yeme sefira peturin. vechen metzora sheshshachat chattato vaashamo bachutz betoch yeme hassefira patur. sheadayin lo niru baale hakkarbanot haellu lechappara. aval im shachatu olotehen bachutz betoch yeme hassefira chayyavin. shehaola doron hi vehachattat vehaasham hi ikkar hakkappara. vechen nazir sheshshachat chattato bachutz betoch yeme neziruto patur. hikriv olato o shelamav bachutz chayyav shehachattat hi hammeakkavto vehi ikkar hannezirut:

Asham taluy vechattat haof habbaa al hassafek shehikrivan bachutz patur shehare lo nikba haissur. asham metzora sheshshechato bachutz shello lishmo chayyav hoil veshello lishmo rauy bifnim vechasher kemo sheyyitbaer. vechol karban shehu patur al shechitato bachutz kach hu patur al haalaato:

Shene seire yom hakkippurim sheshshechatam bachutz. im ad shello hitvadda alehem chayyav karet al shenehen hoil ureuyin lavo lifne hashshem levidduy. veim achar shehitvadda patur al hammishtalleach shehare eno rauy lavo lifne hashshem:

Hashshochet shelamim bachutz kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechol patur. shehare hen mechussarim maase veachar kach yihyu reuyin likkarev lifne hashshem kemo shebbearnu. vehashshochet et happesach bachutz afillu bishar yemot hashshana ben lishmo ben shello lishmo chayyav. shehappesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim hu:
Behemat chullin sheubbarah kadshe mizbeach asur leshochotah bachutz. veim shechatah eno loke mippene sheenah reuya lavo lifne hashshem:
Ganav vehikdish veachar kach shachat bachutz chayyav. umeematay heemiduha birshuto kede lechayyevo aleha karet. mishshaa shehikdishah. vehu sheshshechatah achar yeush aval lifne yeush enah kedosha:

Hayta habbehema kullah bachutz vetzavvarah bifnim veshachat chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 3)</small> "asher yishchat shor o keves o ez bammachane o asher yishchat michutz lammachane". echad hashshochet bammikdash vetzavvarah bifnim ushear guf habbehema bachutz o shehaya gufah bifnim vetzavvarah bachutz chayyav ad shettihye habbehema kullah bammikdash shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "veel petach ohel moed lo yeviennu". aval hashshochet begaggo shel hechol af al pi sheeno rauy lizvicha kelal hare ze patur:

Shenayim sheachazu bassakkin veshachatu bachutz peturin shenneemar asher yishchat <small>(Vayikra 17 3)</small> "o asher yishchat" echad velo shenayim. veechad sheshshachat bachutz af al pi shello nitkavven lishchot kadashim ellu laAdonai hare ze chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 4)</small> "dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach". af al pi shezze haddam bemachashavto kaddam hannishpach lo kakkarban hare ze chayyav:

Hashshochet bachutz ballayla chayyav hoil vehashshechita ballayla keshera bachutz. vechen im heela ballayla mizze sheshshachat bachutz ballayla chayyav al haalaa. aval im shachat bifnim ballayla veheela bachutz patur. lefi shello heela ella davar pasul sheen lecha shechita keshera ballayla bammikdash. vechen im kibbel bichli chol bifnim vezarak bachutz patur:

Vechen hammolek et haof bachutz patur. veim heelahu patur. malak bifnim veheela bachutz chayyav al haalaa. shachat bifnim veheelahu bachutz patur shello heela ella davar sheeno rauy likkarev. shachat et haof bachutz veheelahu bachutz chayyav shetayim shehashshechita bachutz keshera vahare hi kimlika bifnim:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 19:
En hammaale bachutz chayyav ad sheyyaale lerosh hammizbeach sheyyaase bachutz. aval im heela al hassela o al haeven patur. sheen karuy karban ella al hammizbeach veaf al pi shehu bachutz shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 8 20)</small> "vayyiven noach mizbeach". veeno chayyav ad sheyyaale lashshem shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "laasot oto laAdonai" ad sheyyitkavven lashshem:
Eno chayyav ella al haalaat davar harauy laishshim velammizbeach kegon haola shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "asher yaale ola o zavach" ma ola sheruya laishshim af kol sherauy laishshim hu shechayyavin al haalaato bachutz:
Mikkan amru hazzorek et haddam o hammaktir evre ola o emurin o kometz o levona o ketoret o minchat kohanim o minchat nesachim o hamenassech shelosha login yayin o mayim bachutz chayyav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 9)</small> "lo yeviennu laasot oto" kol hammitkabbel bifnim chayyavin alav bachutz:
Aval hazzorek sheyare haddam bachutz afillu sheyare damim happenimim patur. shezzerikat sheyare haddam sheyare mitzva hem veenan meakkevin. vechen hamenassech yayin o mayim pachot mishshelosha login bachutz patur ben bechag ben bishar yemot hashshana. hoil vechaser hashshiur hare enan reuyin lehitkabbel bifnim. vechen hammaale mibbesar chattat mibbesar asham mibbesar shelamim ben shel yachid ben shel tzibbur mishsheyare menachot mishshete hallechem millechem happanim bachutz patur. shekkol ellu reuyin laachila lo laishshim:
Hammaale et habbehema kullah bachutz chayyav mippene haemurin. veaf al pi shello hifrishan en besar hazzevach chotzetz. ucheillu hiktir haemurim bifne atzman. aval hammaale mincha shello nikmetza patur. sheen hakkometz barur umuvdal. kematzah vechazar kumtzah letochah vehikriv kullah bachutz chayyav:
Hayyotzek vehabbolel vehappotet vehammoleach vehammenif vehammaggish vehamesadder et hashshulchan vehammetiv et hannerot vehakkometz vehamekabbel damim bachutz patur. lefi shekkol echad meellu eno gemar avoda veneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 8)</small> "asher yaale ola o zavach". ma haalaa shehi gemar avoda af kol shehu gemar avoda chayyavin alav:

Mi sheanasuhu ad shemmachar velakach deme hammikkach. afillu taluhu ad shemmachar mimkaro mimkar ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot shemmippene anso gamar umakne. af al pi shello lakach haddamim bifne haedim. lefichach im masar modaa kodem sheyyimkor veamar lishne edim deu shezze sheani mocher chefetz peloni o sade peloni lifloni mippene sheani anus. hare hammimkar batel. vaafillu hechezik kamma shanim motziin otah miyyado umachazir haddamim: 
Utzerichin haedim leda shehu mocher mippene haones veshehu anus vadday. lo sheyyismechu al piv. vechol modaa sheen katuv bah veanu haedim yadanu sheppeloni ze anus haya enah modaa: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemocher o beose peshara. aval bemattana o bimchila im masar modaa kodem mattana af al pi sheeno anus hare hammattana betela. sheen holchin bemattana ella achar gilluy daat hannoten sheim eno rotze lehakenot bechol libbo lo kana hamekabbel mattana. vehammechila mattana hi: 
Echad haones et chavero beshehikkahu o telaahu ad shemmachar o shehifchido bedavar sheefshar lo laasot ben bide akkum ben bide yisrael hare ze ones. umaase beechad shessachar pardes mechavero leeser shanim velo haya shetar chov beyad hammaskir veachar sheachalo hassocher shalosh shanim amar lo im lo timkerenu li echbosh shetar sechirut veeton shehu lakuach beyadi veamru chachamim shezze ones. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefichach im tevao hammaskir bevet din vechafar bo vetaan shehappardes shello veachar kach masar hammaskir modaa veachar kach machar lassocher shekkafar bo hare hammimkar batel. shehare yesh lo edim shehu anus. vehem haedim shekkafar bifnehem bevet din vehem ede hammodaa. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Bamme devarim amurim beannas shehare hu chamsan mippene shekkofe et hammocher limkor shello birtzono. aval haggozel vehuchzak begazlan veachar kach lakach sade sheggazal en hammocher tzarich limsor modaa kemo shebbearnu behilchot gezela: 
Ede hammodaa yesh lahem lachtom hem atzman beoto hammimkar shennimsera lahem hammodaa alav veen bechach kelum. vaafillu amar lahem bifne haannas birtzoni macharti belo ones hare hammodaa kayyemet. keshem sheanaso shemmachar belo ratzon kach anaso ad sheamar birtzoni ani mocher: 
Vechen im hoda bifnehem shellakach haddamim achar shemmasar modaa al kach eno chayyav lehachezir kelum. shehaones anaso ad sheyyode vehaedim kevar yadu shehu anus. aval im mana haddamim bifnehem chayyav lehachezir: 
Heidu alav ede hammecher shebbittel hammodaa hare hammodaa betela. veim amar leede hammodaa heyu yodin shekkol kinyan sheani lokeach levattel hammodaa umodae demodae shehakkol batel veeni omer kach ella mippene haones sheattem yodin veen bedati lehakenot leze haannas leolam. hare hammecher batel. veaf al pi shekkanu miyyado levattel hammodaa al hadderech shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 11:
Hammaknne ben karka bin mittaltelin vehitna tenain sheefshar lekayyeman. ben shehitna hammakne ben shehitna hakkone. im nitkayyemu hattenain nikna haddavar shehukna. veim lo nitkayyem hattenay lo kana. uchevar bearnu mishpete hattenaim behilchot ishut: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshekkana bederech min hadderachim shekkonin bahen vahare yesh alav lekayyem et hattenay. aval im lo kana atta vehitna immo sheim nitkayyem hattenay ze yikne veim lo nitkayyem lo yikne af al pi shennitkayyem hattenay lo kana. shezzo asmachta hi. shehare samach keniyyato laasot kach vechach vechol asmachta enah kona shehare lo gamar belibbo lehakenoto: 
Ketzad. hammocher bayit lachavero o netano lo bemattana al menat sheyyelech immo lirushalayim beyom peloni. vehechezik ze babbayit. hare ze kana kesheyyelech immo lirushalayim beoto hayyom. veim avar oto hayyom velo halach lo kana. aval im hitna veamar lo im telech immi lirushalayim beyom peloni o im tavi li davar peloni etten lecha bayit ze o emkerenu lecha bechach vechach. vehalach immo beoto hayyom o shehevi lo. af al pi shehechzik babbayit achar shekkiyyem hattenay lo kana shezzo hi asmachta. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Lefichach hannoten eravon lachavero veamar lo im ani chozer bi ervoni machul lecha vehalla omer veim ani chozer bi echpol lecha ervoncha. im chazar bo hallokeach kana ze haeravon shehare hu tachat yado. veim chazar bo hammocher en mechayyevin oto lichpol haeravon shezzo asmachta hi veasmachta lo kana:
Vechen mi sheppara miktzat chovo vehishlish et hashshetar veamar lo im lo natatti lecha ad yom peloni ten lo shetaro vehiggia zeman velo natan lo. lo yitten hashshalish et hashshetar shezzo asmachta hi:
Vechen kol tenain shemmatnin bene adam benehen. af al pi shehen beedim uvishtar. im yihye kach o im taase kach etten lecha mane o akne lecha bayit ze. veim lo yihye o lo taase lo akne lecha velo etten lecha. af al pi sheasa o shehaya haddavar lo kana. shekkol haomer im yihye im lo yihye lo gamar vehikna. shehare dato adayin somechet shemma yihye o shemma lo yihye: 
Kol haomer kene meachshav en kan asmachta kelal vekana. sheillu lo gamar lehakenoto lo hiknahu meachshav. ketzad. im bati mikkan vead yom peloni kene bayit ze meachshav vekanu miyyado al kach. hare ze kana im ba betoch hazzeman shekkava. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi shemmachar chatzero o sadehu. uferesh bishat hammechira shehu mocher kede lelech lemakom peloni o mippene hammatar shennimna kede liknot chittim bidme chatzero hare ze kemocher al tenay. lefichach im yarad hammatar achar shemmachar. o bau chittin vehuzelu. o nimna hadderech lelech leotah haaretz. o shello nistayyea lo laalot o liknot chittim. hare ze machzir otan haddamim vetachzor lo karka. shehare peresh sheeno mocher ella laasot davar peloni vahare lo naasa. vechen kol kayyotze bahen: 
Aval hammocher setam af al pi shehaya belibbo shemmippene kach vechach hu mocher. veaf al pi shemmarin haddevarim sheeno mocher ella laasot kach vechach velo naasa eno chozer. shehare lo peresh udevarim shebballev enan devarim: 
Mi shehikna lachavero vehitna alav al menat shettitten mikkach ze o timkerenu lifloni. im netano o mecharo leoto peloni kana. veim lo kiyyem hattenay umecharo leacher o shello mecharo velo netano bazzeman shekkava lo lo kana. vechen hammocher o hallokeach shehitnu sheyyachzir lo hammikkach bizman peloni o kesheyyitten lo hammaot. hare hammecher kayyam veyachzir keshehitna: 
Machar karka lachavero vehitna hammocher veamar lallokeach kesheyyihyu li maot tachzir li hakkarka zo hare happerot shel mocher. machar lo setam veamar lo hallokeach middato kesheyyihyu lecha maot teviem li vaani achzir lecha karka zo. hare hattenay kayyam vehallokeach ochel perot. veen baze avak ribbit shehare middato chiyyev atzmo bitnay ze: 
Maase beishsha sheshshalcha reuven liknot lah chatzer mishshimon shehaya kerovo veamar shimon hammocher liruven hashshaliach im yihyu li maot tachzir li pelonit kerovati karka zo. veheshivo reuven veamar lo atta ufelonit kerovim kemo achim. kelomar haddavar karov shehi tachzir lecha veenah makpedet al zo. uva maase lifne chachamim veamru hare ze hashshaliach lo kana kelum shehare lo samcha dato shel karov ze al divre hashshaliach mippene shello heshivo teshuva berura venimtza shello gamar velo hikna. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Asmachta shekkanu miyyado aleha bevet din chashuv hare ze kana. vehu sheyyitpos zechuyyotav bevet din. vehu shello yihye anus: 
Ketzad. hare shehitpis shetaro o shovro bevet din. vekanu miyyado sheim lo ba beyom peloni yinnaten shetar ze levaal dino vehiggia hayyom velo ba hare ellu notnim. veim ikkevo nahar o choli millavo lo yittenu. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vehu sheyyihye bevet din chashuv: 
Hamechayyev atzmo bemamon leacher belo tenay kelal. af al pi shello haya chayyav lo kelum hare ze chayyav. sheddavar ze mattana hi veenah asmachta. ketzad. haomer leedim hevu alay edim sheani chayyav lifloni mane. o shekkatav lo bishtar hareni chayyav lecha mane af al pi sheen sham edim. o sheamar lo bifne edim hareni chayyav lecha mane bishtar. af al pi shello amar attem eday. hoil veamar bishtar hare ze kemi sheamar hevu alay edim vechayyav leshallem. af al pi sheshshenehem modim vehaedim yodim shello haya lo etzlo kelum. shehare chiyyev atzmo. kemo sheyyishtabed hearev. vechaze horu rov haggeonim: 
Chiyyev atzmo bedavar sheeno katzuv. kegon sheamar hareni chayyav lazun otcha o lechassot chamesh shanim. af al pi shekkanu miyyado lo nishtabed. shezzo kemo mattana hi veen kan davar yadua umatzuy shennetano bemattana. vechen horu rabbotay: 
Umippene ma happosek im ishto sheyyihye zan et bittah chayyav lezunah. mippene sheppasak bishat nissuin vehaddavar dome lidvarim hanniknin baamira: 
Keshehayu chachme sefarad rotzim lehakenot beasmachta kach hayu osin. konin mizze shehu chayyav lachavero mea dinarin. veachar shechiyyev atzmo konin mibbaal chovo shekkol zeman sheyyihye kach o sheyyaase kach hare hachov ze machul lo meachshav. veim lo yihye o lo yaase hareni tovo bemamon shechiyyev atzmo bo. veal derech zo hayinu osin bechol hattenain shebben adam leishto beshidduchin uvechol haddevarim haddomin lahem:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 12:
Asur lammocher o lakkone lehonot et chavero shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 14)</small> "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha al tonu". veaf al pi shehu over belo taase eno loke mippene shennittan lehishshavon. uven shehona bemezid ben shello yada sheyyesh bemecher ze honaya chayyav leshallem: 
Vechamma tehe honaya veyihye chayyav lehashiv. shetut beshave. ketzad. hare shemmachar sheve shesh bechamesh. o sheve sheva beshesh. o sheve chamesh beshesh. o sheve shesh besheva. hare ze honaya venikne hammikkach vechayyav hameanne leshallem et hahonaya ulehachazirah kullah lammitanne: 
Hayta hahonaya pachot mizze bechol shehu. kegon shemmachar sheve shishshim dinar bachamishshim uferuta. eno chayyav lehachezir kelum. shekkol pachot mishshetut derech hakkol limchol bo: 
Hayta hahonaya yetera al hashshetut bechol shehu. kegon shemmachar sheve shishshim bachamishshim pachot peruta. batel mikkach. vehammitanne yachol lehachezir hachefetz velo yikne kelal. aval hameanne oto eno yachol lachzor im ratza ze vekibbel. veaf al pi shebbatal hammikkach. en hameanne chayyav lehachezir ad shettihye hahonaya yeter al peruta. hayta peruta beshave eno machzir sheen honaya lifrutot: 
Ad matay yihye lo lachzor velitboa hahonaya o levattel hammikkach. ad kede sheyyare letaggar o likrovo. veim shaha yoter mizze afillu lakach sheve mea bematayim eno chozer: 
Bamme devarim amurim belokeach shehare hammikkach beyado umarehu. aval hammocher chozer behonaya leolam. veen tzarich lomar bevittul mikkach sheeno yodea deme ze shemmachar ad sheyyire kemoto shennimkar bashshuk. lefichach im haya hammikkach davar sheen bemino shinnuy vehu kullo shave kegon pilpelin vechayyotze bahen hare ze eno chozer ella ad kede sheyyishal al shaar shebbashshuk bilvad: 
Vechen im noda shebba leyado kemimkaro veyada shettaa velo tava eno yuchal lachzor velitboa shehare machal: 
Keshem shehonaya lehedyot kach honaya letaggar af al pi shehu baki. ucheshem shehonaya beferot uvivhema kach yesh din honaya bematbeot: 
Ketzad. hare shehaya dinar shel zahav beesrim vearbaa dinar shel kesef vetzerfa beesrim dinar o beesrim ushemona hare ze machzir et hahonaya. haya yater al ze batel hatztzeruf. pachot mikkan mechila: 
Vechen im haya hassela chasera shetut vehayu motziin hasselaim beminyan velo bemishkal machzir hahonaya: 
Ad matay chayyav lehachezir haddinar o hassela. bakkerakkim ad kede sheyyare lashshulchani. bichfarim sheen hashshulchani matzuy sham yesh lo lehachezir ad arve shabbatot. sheen makkir hassela vechesronah vedameha ella hashshulchani. vehu haddin lemocher sefarim avanim tovot umargaliyyot sheyyesh lallokeach lachzor ad sheyyare otam letaggarim habbekiim bahen bechol makom shehen. sheen hakkol bekiim bidvarim ellu. lefichach im lo haya makkir beotah medina veholich hammikkach lemakom acher. o shebba habbaki leachar zeman merubbe vehodio shettaa. hare ze chozer: 
Hannoten sela chasera lachavero im haya makkirah afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh hare ze machzirah. veim haya efshar lehotziah al yede haddechak eno yachol lehachezirah leachar zeman ella im ken kibbelah mimmennu bemiddat chasidut: 
Hammocher lachavero sheve arba bechamesh shehare hammikkach batel kemo shebbearnu velo hispik lehareot letaggar o likrovo ad shehukar veamad besheva. lokeach yachol lachzor bo velo hammocher. shehare hallokeach omer lammocher illu lo honetani lo hayita yachol lachzor veatta shehonetani tachzor heach yihye hachote niskar: 
Vechen mocher shemmachar sheve chamesh bearba vezal veamad beshalosh. mocher yachol lachzor bo velo lokeach. shehare omer lo hammocher lallokeach lo mippene shehonetani tachzor becha: 
Hammocher sheve chamesh beshesh velo hispik lehareoto ad shehukar veamad bishmone. hare hammocher chayyav lehachezir haachat shel honaya shehare nikna hammikkach vechayyav lehachezir ucheshehokir birshut lokeach hukar. vechen im machar shave shesh bechamesh vehuzelu veamdu al shalosh. hare hallokeach chayyav lehachezir sela achat shel honaya. shehare nikna hammikkach uvirshut hallokeach huzal:

Hammachlif kelim bechelim o behema bivhema afillu machat beshirayim o tale besus en lo honaya. shezze rotze bemachat yoter min hashshirayim. aval hammachlif perot beferot ben sheshshamu otam kodem hammechira ben sheshshamu otam achar mechira yesh lahen honaya: 
Hallokeach bedamim achsara kegon shechafan mimmaot veamar lo mechor li paratcha beellu. af al pi shekkone bachalifin kana umachazir honaa kemo shebbearnu. vehu haddin lelokeach perot achsara besela o bishtayim shekkana umachazir onaa. baal habbayit shemmachar kele tashmisho en lo honaya. sheillule lo hirbu lo haddamim lo haya mocher lo kele tashmisho: 
Haomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaya yesh lo alav honaya. bamme devarim amurim bistam sheen yodea kamma honaya yesh bo kede sheyyimchol. veen tzarich lomar im amar lo al menat sheen bo honaya shehare yesh bo. aval bimfaresh en lo honaya shekkol tenay shebbammamon kayyam: 
Ketzad. mocher sheamar lallokeach chefetz ze sheani noten bematayim yodea ani sheeno shave ella mane al menat sheen lecha honaya ani mocher lecha en lo alav honaya. vechen lokeach sheamar lammocher chefetz ze sheani lokeach mimmecha bemane yodea ani sheshshave matayim al menat sheen lecha alay honaya ani lokeach mimmecha. en lo alav honaya: 
Hannose vehannoten beemuna en lo alav onaya. ketzad. chefetz ze bechach vechach lekachtiv kach vechach ani mistakker bo. en lo alav honaya: 
Vhannose vehannoten beemuna im lakach kelim rabbim o begadim bemimkar echad. lo yachshov et hara beemuna veet hayyafe beshave ella ze veze beemuna o ze veze beshavin. veyesh lo lehaalot al hammikkach sechar hakkattaf. usechar hachammar. usechar pundak. aval sechar atzmo mippene shehu kefoel eno mosif oto al hammikkach. ella mefaresh veomer lo kach vechach ani mistakker: 
Haakkum en lo honaya shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 14)</small> "ish et achiv". veakkum shehona et yisrael machzir honaya bedinin shellanu. lo yihye ze chamur miyyisrael: 
Ellu devarim sheen lahem honaya. hakkarkaot vehaavadim vehashshetarot vehahekdeshot. afillu machar sheve elef bedinar o sheve dinar beelef en bahen honaya. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 14)</small> "o kano miyyad amitecha". davar hannikne miyyad leyad. yatzu hakkarkaot veyatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot. veyatzu shetarot sheen gufan kanuy ella liraya shebbahen. amitcha velo hekdesh: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemocher nichse atzmo. aval hashshaliach shettaa bechol shehu ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot chozer. venire li shekken haddin beappotroppos shettaa bechol shehu. ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot chozer. veeno dome levet din mippene shehu yachid: 
Bet din shemmachru nichse yetomim vetau ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin. im tau befachot mishshetut hare zo mechila kehedyot. tau bishtut batel hammikkach. veim ratzu shello levattel hammimkar veyachziru hahonaya machazirin. lo yihye koach hedyot chamur mehen: 
Nire li shebbet din shemmachru karka o avadim shel yetomim sheve mane bematayim. en hallokeach yachol lachzor bahen. lo yihye koach hedyot chamur mikkoach hayetomim. vechen haddin beappotroppos shemmachar karka vaavadim sheen hallokeach yachol lachzor behonaya kedin hahedyot: 
Haachin vehashshuttafin shechalku hammittaltelin hare hen kelakochot. pachot mishshetut nikne mikkach veen machzir kelum. yeter al shetut batel mikkach. shetut kana umachazir onaa. veim hitnu benehem sheyyachleku beshum haddayyanin vetau bishtut batla chaluka. shehaddayyanin sheshshamu ufachatu shetut o hotiru shetut michran batel: 
Habbehema vehammargalit vehassayif. vesefer tora hare hen kishar mittaltelin veyesh bahen honaya. en lecha davar sheen bo honaya chutz mearbaa devarim shemmanu chachamim. vehu sheyyihye mocher kone benichse atzmo kemo shebbearnu: 
Keshem sheen lekarkeot honaya kach sechirut karka en lo honaya. afillu sachar teraklin gadol bedinar beshana o refet ketanna bedinar bechol yom en lo honaya: 
Hassocher et happoel laasot immo ben bekarka ben bemittaltelin en lo honaya. mippene shehu kekone oto lizman. vaavadim en bahem honaya: 
Secharo lizroa lo karka veamar zarati bah zeria harauy bah uvau edim shezzara bah pachot min harauy lah. hare ze safek im yesh lo honaya mippene hazzera o en lo honaya mippene hakkarka. lefichach en motziin miyyad nitba. vechen en mashbiin oto ella shevuat hesset mippene tzad hakkarka sheyyesh kan: 
Hassocher et hakkelim o et habbehema yesh lahem onaya. shehassechirut mechira bat yomah hi. veim yesh bah honaya shetut o yoter. ben shennitanna socher ben shennitanna maskir. hare ze machzir honaya vaafillu leachar zeman merubbe: 
Nire li shehakkabbelan yesh lo honaa. ketzad. kegon shekkibbel alav leerog beged ze baasara zuzim. o litpor chaluk ze bishne zuzim. hare ze yesh lo honaya. vechol echad mishshenehem ben kabbelan ben baal habbeged chozer leolam kemocher:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 14:
Kevar bearnu shehannosi venotin beemuna veamar kach vechach ani mistakker en lo honaya. vaafillu amar ze lakachti besela uveeser ani mocher muttar. aval bet din chayyavin lifsok hashshearim ulehaamid shotrin lechach. velo yihye kol echad veechad mistakker kol ma sheyyirtze ella shetut bilvad yifseku lahem bischaram. velo yistakker hammocher yeter al shetut: 
Bamme devarim amurim bidvarim sheyyesh bahem chayye nefesh kegon yenot shemanim uselatot. aval haikkarin kegon hakkosht vehallevona vechayyotze bahen en poskin lahem shaar ella yistakker kol ma sheyyirtze: 
Veen mistakkerin paamayim bevetzim ella hattaggar harishon hu mochran besachar vehallokeach mimmennu mochran bekeren bilvad: 
Asur laasot sechora beeretz yisrael bidvarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh. ella ze mevi miggarno umocher veze mevi miggarno umocher kede sheyyimkerennu bezol. uvemakom shehashshemen merubbe muttar lehistakker beshemen: 
En otzrin perot sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh baaretz yisrael vechen bechol makom sherubbo yisrael shehare maggia middavar ze tzaar leyisrael. bamme devarim amurim belokeach min hashshuk. aval hammachnis mishshello muttar laasot lo kabbo otzar: 
Muttar leetzor perot shalosh shanim erev sheviit usheviit umotzae sheviit. uvishne batztzoret afillu kav charuvin lo yeetzor mippene shemmachnis meera bashshearim. vechol hammafkia shearim o sheatzar perot baaretz o bemakom sherubbo yisrael hare ze kemalve beribbit: 
Bamme devarim amurim beferot sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh. aval hattavlin kegon kammon ufilpelin muttar leetzor otan beeretz yisrael ulehotzi otan mimmakom lemakom kishar haikkarin: 
En motziin perot sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh kegon yenot shemanim uselatot meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz o lesureya. velo mershut melech ze lirshut melech acher beeretz yisrael: 
Rashshain bene hair lakotz lahem shaar lechol davar sheyyirtzu vaafillu basar velechem ulehatnot benehem lechol mi sheyyaavor yaanshu oto kach vechach: 
Rashshain anshe ummanuyyot lifsok benehem shello yaase echad beyom sheyyaase chavero vechayyotze baze vechol mi sheyyaavor al hattenay yaanshu oto kach vechach: 
Bamme devarim amurim bimdina sheen bah chacham chashuv letakken maase hammedina ulehatzliach darche yoshveha. aval im yesh bah adam chacham chashuv en hattenay shellahen moil kelum veen yecholin laanosh ulehafsid al mi shello kibbel hattenay ella im ken hitna immahem veasu middaat hechacham. vechol mi shehifsid lefi hattenay sheeno middaat hechacham meshallem: 
Keshem shehonaya bemikkach umimkar kach yesh honaya bidvarim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 17)</small> "velo tonu ish et amito veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai". ze honayat devarim:

Hammocher lachavero bemidda bemishkal o beminyan vetaa bechol shehu chozer leolam. sheen honaya ella bedamim aval becheshbon chozer: 
Ketzad. machar lo mea egozim bedinar venimtzeu mea veechad o tishim vetisha. nikna hammikkach umachazir et hattaut vaafillu leachar kamma shanim. vechen im nimtzeu hammaot chaser o yater min hamminyan sheppasku chozer vaafillu leachar shekkanu miyyado shello nishar lo etzel chavero kelum chozer shekkinyan betaut hu. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Vechen hammocher lachavero karka o eved o behema o shear mittaltelin venimtza bammikkach mum shello yada bo hallokeach. machziro afillu leachar kamma shanim shezze mikkach taut hu. vehu shello yishtammesh bammikkach achar sheyyada bammum. aval im nishtammesh bo achar sheraa hammum hare ze machal veeno yachol lehachezir: 
En mechashshevin pechat hammum. afillu machar lo keli shave asara dinarin venimtza bo mum hammafchito middamo isar machzir et hakkeli veeno yachol lomar lo helach isar pechat hammum. shehallokeach omer bechefetz shalem ani rotze. vechen im ratza hallokeach likkach pechat hammum harshut beyad hammocher. shehu omer lo o tikne oto kemo shehu o tol damim shellecha velech:

Hammocher eved o shifcha. en hallokeach yachol lehacheziro mippene mumin sheen mevattelin oto mimmelachto vehen hannikrain simpon. sheim haya ze simpon galuy kevar raahu. veim eno nire kegon shuma babbasar o neshichat kelev o reach happe o hachotem vechayyotze bahen hoil veeno mevattelo mimmelachto eno machzir. sheen haavadim letashmish hammitta ella limlacha:

Veen kol ellu haddevarim amurim ella bemakom sheen lahem minhag aval bemakom sheyyesh lahem minhag hakkol keminhag hammedina:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehotzi hammikkach miyyad hallokeach bevet din shel yisrael. kegon shehaya hammikkach mittaltelin vehayu genuvin o gezulin o shehayta hakkarka gezula. o shebba baal chov shel mocher uterafah miyyad hallokeach vehakkol bevet din shel yisrael. aval im haoved kochavim hu shehotzi hammikkach min hallokeach ben bedin hammelech ben bearkaot shellahen. en hammocher chayyav beacharayuto. veaf al pi shehaoved kochavim toen shehammocher ganav chefetz ze o gezalah mimmennu vehevi ede akkum al kach en hammocher chayyav kelum. shezze ones hu veen hammocher chayyav beacharayut ones: 
Hammocher karka lachavero vehitna immo shekkol ones sheyyivvaled bekarka ze yihye chayyav leshallem. afillu ba akkum ugezalah mechamat hammocher chayyav leshallem. aval im nifsak hannahar shehaya mashke otah. o shechazar hannahar laavor betochah venaaset berecha. o shebbaa zevaa vehishchita otah. hare ze patur. sheellu vechayyotze bahen ones sheeno matzuy hu velo ala al lev hammocher devar ze happele beet shehitna. vechol ones sheeno matzuy eno bichlal hattenay hazze: 
Vehu haddin lechol tenay mamon sheomdin daat hammatne veen kollin beoto hattenay ella devarim hayeduin shebbichlalan haya hattenay vehem shehayu bedaat hammatne bishat shehitna: 
Maase beechad shessachar mallachim lehavi shumshemin lemakom peloni. vehitna immahem shehen chayyavin bechol ones sheyyeera lahem ad sheyyaggiu hashshumshemin lemakom peloni. venifsak hannahar shehayu molichin bo. veamru chachamim ze ones sheeno matzuy veen chayyavin leholich shumshemin ellu al gabbe behema ad oto makom. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammocher karka lachavero vehitna hammocher shello yihye alav acharayut. afillu noda bevadday shezzo haaretz gezula veyatzat miyyad hallokeach. en hammocher chayyav kelum. veen tzarich lomar im ba baal chov uterafah sheeno machzir lo kelum. shekkol tenay shebbemamon kayyam: 
Reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beacharayut. uva levi vehotziah miyyad shimon. im ratza reuven laasot din im levi ose. veen yachol levi lomar lo ma li ulecha vahare en alecha acharayut. shehare reuven omer lo en retzoni sheyyihye leshimon taromet alay shehare hifsid biglali: 
Reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beacharayut vechazar ulekachah mishshimon beacharayut. uva baal chov shel reuven litrof otah mimmennu. eno yachol lachzor al shimon. sheaf al pi shello kibbel alav acharayut leshimon acharayut atzmo kibbel shello yihye hu hammocher vehu hammotzi leatzmo. aval im ba baal chov shel yaakov avihem uterafah miyyad reuven. chozer bechol haddamim al shimon. mippene sheshshimon kibbel lo haacharayut ureuven lo kibbel leshimon acharayut shel acherim kelal:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 20:
Hamevakesh liknot mechavero mikkach. mocher omer bematayim ani mocher lecha vehallokeach omer eni kone ella bemane. vehalach ze leveto veze leveto veachar kach nitkabbetzu umashach ze hachefetz setam. im hammocher hu shettava hallokeach venatan lo hachefetz eno noten ella mane. veim hallokeach hu shebba umashach ze hachefetz setam chayyav litten matayim: 
Hallokeach meechad mechamishsha bene adam vechol echad mehen tovea oto veomer ani hu baal hammikkach. vehu eno yodea mimmi mehem lakach. manniach deme hammikkach benehem umistallek veyihyu haddamim munnachin ad sheyyodu o ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. veim hu chasid noten damim lechol echad veechad kede latzet yede shamayim: 
Lakach mikkach meechad mechamishsha bene adam vechafar bo venishba al sheker veasa teshuva vahare hu rotze leshallem vechol echad veechad tovea oto veomer ani hu shekkafarta bi venishbata li vehu omer eni yodea. chayyav leshallem lechol echad veechad mippene sheavar avera: 
Neeman baal hammikkach lomar laze macharti velaze lo macharti. ematay bizman shehammikkach yotze mittachat yado. aval im en hammikkach yotze mittachat yado hare hu ed echad bilvad. vedino beedut zo kedin kol adam shehare eno nogea beeduto. lefichach im natal haddamim mishshenayim venatal meechad middato umeechad baal karcho velo yada mimmi natal middato umimmi natal beal karcho. ben shehaya hammikkach beyado ben shehayu shenehen tofsin bo en kan edut kelal. vechol echad mehen nishba betakkanat chachamim binkitat chefetz venotel chatzi hammikkach vachatzi damim: 
Hare shettaan al chavero veamar macharta li. veze omer lo macharti. o macharti velo natatta li damim. o shettaan hallokeach veamar shennatan haddamim vaadayin lo mashach. o mashachti velo raiti mum ze. vehammocher omer lo hodativ lecha. o sheamar echad mehem kach vechach tenay haya benenu vehaechad omer lo haya sham tenay kelal. bechol ellu hatteanot vechayyotze bahen hammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Lo hayta sham reaya. nishba hakkofer shemmevakkeshin lehotzi miyyado shevuat hesset. veim hoda bemiktzat hattaana o sheyyesh alav ed echad nishba shevuat hattora kishar hatteanot kullan: 
Amar lechenvani ten li bedinar perot venatan lo vahare happerot munnachin birshut harabbim. vehachenvani tovea et haddinar uvaal habbayit omer lo natatti lecha haddamim vehishlachta otam letoch kischa. hare hallokeach nishba ketakkanat chachamim binkitat chefetz venotel happerot hoil uchevar yatzu mershut hammocher vahare hen birshut harabbim. veillu hayu birshut hallokeach haya nishba shevuat hesset veniftar. veillu hayu adayin birshut hachenvani haya nishba hesset veyishshaaru perotav etzlo: 
Natan hallokeach dinar lechenvani uva littol perot hammunnachin birshut harabbim. veamar hachenvani dinar ze shennatatta li achshav hu deme perot shekkevar netattim lecha veholachtam letoch betcha aval perot ellu hammunnachin birshut harabbim lo mechartim lecha. hare hachenvani nishba binkitat chefetz shekkach haya haddavar umachazir perotav lachenvani. shehare lo hoda lo shemmecharan lo meolam. veillu hayu bachanuto haya nishba shevuat hesset kemo shebbearnu: 
Vechen haddin benoten dinar leshulchani littol maot. bizman shehammaot tzevurin birshut harabbim. im hashshulchani hoda shemmecharan vaadayin lo natal haddinar nishba hallokeach binkitat chefetz shennatan venotel hammaot. veim lo hoda shemmecharan lo af al pi shemmode shellakach mimmennu dinar atta vetoen sheddinar ze deme hammaot shekkevar holichan hallokeach letoch beto. hare hashshulchani nishba binkitat chefetz veyachzir meotav lachanuto: 
Hammachlif para bachamor veyalda vechen hammocher shifchato veyalda. ze omer ad shello macharti yalda veze omer mishshellakachti yalda. afillu amar hammocher eni yodea. al hallokeach lehavi reaya. af al pi shehappara omedet baagam vehashshifcha omedet besimta hare hen bechezkat hammocher ad sheyyavi hallokeach reaya. lo hevi reaya yishshava hammocher binkitat chefetz al velad happara. aval al velad hashshifcha eno nishba ella hesset. sheen nishbain binkitat chefetz al haavadim velo al hakkarkaot. kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot toen venitan: 
Ze omer eni yodea veze omer eni yodea veenam birshut echad mehen yachaloku. ze omer birshuti yalda vehaacher shotek zacha hattoen bavvalad: 
Mi shehayu lo shene avadim katan vegadol. o shete sadot achat gedola veachat ketanna. hallokeach omer gedola lakachti vehammocher omer ketanna hi shellakachta. al hallokeach lehavi reaya. o yishshava hammocher hesset shello machar ella katan: 
Amar hallokeach gadol lakachti vehammocher shotek zacha hallokeach baggadol. veim amar hammocher eni yodea al hallokeach lehavi reaya. o nishba hammocher hesset sheeno yodea veen laze ella katan: 
Kol mi shennolad hassafek birshuto alav lehavi reaya. ketzad. hammachlif para bachamor umashach baal hachamor et happara velo hispik baal happara limshoch ze hachamor ad shemmet hachamor al baal hachamor lehavi reaya shehaya chamoro kayyam bishat meshichat happara. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Machat hannimtza boovi bet hakkosot venikkeva oto nekev mefullash. im nimtza aleha koret dam beyadua shezzo nitrefa kodem shechita. lefichach im higlid pi hammakka beyadua shezzo nitrefa shelosha yamim kodem shechita. lo higlid pi hammakka hare haddavar safek veal hattabbach lehavi reaya shekkodem lekichato nitrefa. shehare birshuto nolad hassafek. veim lo hevi reaya yeshallem haddamim lammocher kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 21:
Hammaknne lachavero davar sheeno mesuyyam. im haya mino yadua af al pi sheen middato umishkalo uminyano yadua hare ze kana. veim en mino yadua lo kana: 
Ketzad. arema zo shel chittim ani mocher lecha bechach vechach. martef ze shel yayin ani mocher lecha bechach vechach. sak shel teenim ani mocher lecha bechach vechach. af al pi sheen middat haarema yedua velo mishkal hatteenim velo minyan hakkankannim yadua hare ze mimkaro kayyam af al pi shennimtza chaser o yater al haomed shehaya bedatam. veyesh lahem honaya lefi hashshaar shebbashshuk kemo shebbearnu: 
Aval haomer lachavero kol ma sheyyesh bevayit ze ani mocher lecha bechach vechach. vechol ma sheyyesh beteva zo ani mocher lecha bechach vechach. o bassak hazze ani mocher lecha bechach vechach. veratza hallokeach umashach en kan kinyan. shello samcha dato shel lokeach. shehare eno yodea ma sheyyesh bo im teven o zahav. veen ze ella kimsachek bekubbiyya. vechen kol hayyotze baze: 
Vechen hammocher lachavero baasara dinarin chittim velo pasak kamma sea machar lo noten lo kashshaar shebbashshuk bishat hammechira. vechol hachozer bo meachar netinat haddamim velo ratza kashshaar shehaya bashshuk bishat netinat hammaot mekabbel mi sheppara kemo shebbearnu: 
Hammocher makom lachavero laasot bayit o refet bakar. vechen hamekabbel mechavero laasot lo bet chatnut livno o bet almanut levitto ose lo arba ammot al shesh. machar lo mekom bayit gadol ose shemone al eser. machar lo mekom teraklin ose eser al eser. tarbatz shel chatzer shetem esre al shetem esre. verum kol bayit uvayit kachatzi arko vachatzi rachbo: 
Hammocher makom lachavero laasot lo kevura. o hamekabbel mechavero laasot lo kevura. ose meara ufoteach letochah shemona kevarim shelosha mikkan ushelosha mikkan ushenayim mikkeneged hannichnas lammeara. middat hammeara arba ammot al shesh. vechol kever vekever arba ammot orech verochav shishsha tefachim verum shiva. nimtza ben kol kever vekever shemmin hatztzedadin amma umechetza. uven hashshenayim haemtzaiyyim shete ammot: 
Hammocher lachavero betoch sadehu mekom ammat mayim lehashekot bah bet hashshelachin. noten lo betoch sadehu amma sherachbah shete ammot veamma mikkan veamma mikkan laagappeha. veim machar lo ammat hammayim lehashekot bah besilon. noten lo amma sherachbah amma vachatzi amma mikkan vachatzi amma mikkan laagappeha: 
Ellu haagappin baal hassade notan aval eno zoran. shehazzeraim mechalchelin et hakkarka umekalkelin et ammat hammayim. veammat hammayim zot shekkalu agappeha baal haamma metakkenan baafar otah sade. sheal menat ken kibbel alav hammocher lihyot ammat hammayim betoch sadehu: 
Hammocher lachavero derech betoch sadehu. im derech yachid machar lo noten lo shete ammot umechetza rochav kede sheyyaamod chamor bemassao al orech hadderech. machar lo derech ben ir lair noten lo rochav shemone ammot beorech hadderech. machar lo derech harabbim noten lo rochav shesh esre amma: 
Derech hammelech vederech hakkever en lah shiur. venira li shezze kemocher davar sheen mino yadua: 
Machar lo makom lemaamad noten lo bet arbaa kabbim: 
Haomer lachavero bor uchetaleha ani mocher lecha noten lo rochav hakkotel shelosha tefachim: 
Hammocher sade lachavero umetzer lo metzar echad aroch umetzar echad katzar. im haya haaroch shel ish echad lo kana min haaroch ella keneged katzar. veim haya shel shenayim yikne keneged rosh tor: 
Haya metzar reuven mizrach umaarav umetzar shimon tzafon vedarom tzarich sheyyichtov lo metzar reuven mishshete ruchot umetzar shimon mishshete ruchot: 
Metzer lo metzar rishon umetzar sheni umetzar shelishi velo metzer metzar revii kana hassade kullah aval metzar harvii lo kana. veim haya muvla ben hammetzarim veen alav rechev shel dekalim veen bo tisha kabbin kana af hammetzar harvii. veim lo haya muvla veyesh alav rechev shel dekalim o sheyyesh bo tisha kabbin lo kanahu. haya muvla veyesh alav rechev dekalim o sheyyesh bo tisha kabbin. o shello haya muvla veen alav rechev dekalim veen bo tisha kabbin. hare haddavar masur levet din kefi ma sheyyiru leezo derech sheddatan nota yaasu: 
Siyyem lo et hazzaviyyot bilvad velo siyyem lo et hammetzar shellechol ruach. o shessiyyem lo shene metzarim kemin gam. o shessiyyem lo chelek mikkol ruach veruach. hare ze lo kana et kullam ella yikne mimmenna kefi ma shemmasar lo vechamma sheyyiru haddayyanin: 
Hammocher bayit lachavero bevira gedola. af al pi shemmetzer lo metzarim hachitzonim. veaf al pi sheyyesh sham meat shekkorin levira bayit. lo kana ella habbayit bilvad. shehammetzarim hu shehirchiv lo. veillu machar lo kol habbira haya kotev lo velo hinnachti lefanay bemecher ze kelum. vechen hammocher sade bevika gedola umetzer lo metzare habbika. metzarim hem shehirchiv lo: 
Homer lachavero sadot ani mocher lecha. miut sadot shetayim. amar lo kol sadot afillu shalosh vearba chutz miggannot ufardesim. amar lo nechasim afillu gannot ufardesim chutz mibbattim vaavadim. veim amar lo kol nechasay afillu avadim uvattim vechol hammittaltelin hayyeduim lo. vaafillu tefillin shebberosho bichlal hammecher: 
Haomer lachavero bayit mibbattay veshor mishshevaray ani mocher lecha. noten lo hakkatan shebbahen. met echad min hashshevarim o shennafal echad min habbattim. mare lo ze shemmet o shennafal. sheyyad baal hashshetar al hattachtona: 
Haomer lachavero sade deve chiyya ani mocher lecha. vehayu shete sadot hannikraim beshem ze. eno kone ella happachut shebbahen. vechen kol kayyotze bahen: 
Haomer lachavero sede reuven ani mocher lecha. vechevan shebba hallokeach lehishtammesh bah amar lo hammocher enah zo hassade shehayta shel reuven ella kach hi keruya uleolam lo hayta lo ella zo hi shehayta shel reuven ulekachtiha mimmennu vehi shemmechartiha lecha. al hammocher lehavi reaya. veim lo hevi zoche hallokeach bazo shekkol haam korim shel reuven. vechen kol kayyotze baze hallech achar hashshem shehu pashut befi hakkol: 
Haomer lachavero chatzi sade ani mocher lecha shamin kamma shave kol hassade venoten lo min hakkachush shebbah ma sheshshave chatzi haddamim shel kol hassade. vechen im amar lo chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lecha shamin deme kullah venoten lo bidromah kachatzi kol haddamim umekabbel alav hallokeach laasot bechelko mekom haggader. umeachore haggader samuch laggader charitz katan rachav shelosha tefachim. vechutza lo charitz echad gadol rachav shishsha tefachim. uven shene hacharitzin rachav tefach. kol ze kede shello tikpotz hannemiyya bah vechayyotze bah: 
Hayta lo chatzi sade veamar lachavero chatzi sheyyesh li bassade macharti lecha. kana hachetzi kullo. amar lo chatzi hassade sheyyesh li lo kana ella revia. amar lo metzar sade shemmimmenna [nechleket o shemmimmenna nifseket o shemmimmenna] nechetzet. im amar lo veellu metzareha kana chetzyah. veim lo metzer lo metzareha lo kana ella bet tisha kabbin:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 22: En adam makne davar shello ba laolam. ben bemecher ben bemattana ben bemattenat shechiv mera. ketzad. ma shettotzi sade zo machur lecha. ma sheyyotzi ilan ze natun lecha. tenu ma shetteled behema zo lifloni. lo kana kelum. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hammocher perot dekel lachavero yachol lachzor bo af leachar shebbau happerot laolam. veim shamat hallokeach veachal en motziin miyyado. vechol hachozer bo mishshenehem en chayyav lekabbel mi sheppara:
Aval happosek al shaar shebbashshuk velo haya oto hammin sheppasak alav birshut mocher. chayyav liknot velitten lallokeach ma sheppasak. veim chazar mekabbel mi sheppara:

Mi sheppasak al shaar shebbashshuk sheyyitten arbaa sein besela. im hayu shibbolim hare ze kana lekabbel mi sheppara. vehu sheyyare lo baggoren o sheyyomar lo bashshuk hareni somech alecha. aval im lo nira lo baggoren velo amar lo hareni somech alecha lo samcha dato shel mocher veeno mekabbel mi sheppara. shehare hu omer shemma pasak im acher veen tzarich lechittim ellu:

Davar sheen birshuto shel makne eno nikne. vahare hu kedavar shello ba laolam. ketzad. ma sheirash meabba machur lecha. ma shettaale metzudati min hayyam natun lecha. sade zo lichsheekkachenna kenuya lecha. lo kana kelum. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shehaya morisho goses venatuy lamut veratza limkor minnechasav meat kede lehotzi haddamim betzarche kevura. hoil vehabben ani veim yamtin ad sheyyamut veyimkor yishtahe hammet veyitbazze. tiknu chachamim sheim machar veamar ma sheirash meavi hayyom machur lecha mimkaro kayyam. vechen tzayyad ani sheen lo ma sheyyochal sheamar ma shettaale min hayyam metzudati hayyom machur lecha. mimkaro kayyam mishshum kede chayyav:

Habben shemmachar benichse aviv bechayye aviv umet habben bechayye haav veachar kach met haav. ben habben motzi miyyad hallakochot. shehare aviv machar davar shello ba adayin lirshuto. venimtzeu hannechasim birshut haav veze yoresh avi aviv. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shennatan karka mattana lachavero venatan lo al gabbah mea dinarin. im hayu haddinarin metzuyin birshuto kevan shezzacha bassade zacha baddinarin. veim en lo dinar en mechayyevin et hannoten litten lo mea dinarin ad sheyyavi hazzoche reaya shehaya laze dinarin beet hammattana. vehu haddin lishar mittaltelin shemmakne adam otam al karka. im enam birshut hammocher o hannoten lo kana. sheen adam makne davar sheeno birshuto:

Mi shehaya lo pikkadon beyad acher hare ze maknehu ben bemecher ben bemattana. lefi shehappikkadon birshut bealav hu vahare hu bechezkat shehu kayyam. veim kafar bo ze shehufkad etzlo eno yachol lehakenoto. shezze kemi sheavad sheeno birshuto. aval hammilve hoil ulehotzaa nittena enah baolam veen adam yachol lehakenotah ella bemaamad shelashtan. vehu davar sheen lo taam kemo shebbearnu. veim hayta milve bishtar makne et hashshetar bichtiva umesira shehare yesh kan davar hannimsar liknot shibud shebbo:

Keshem sheen adam makne davar shello ba laolam. kach en adam makne lemi shello ba laolam. vaafillu ubbar hare hu kemi shello ba laolam. vehamezakke leubbar lo kana. veim haya beno hoil vedato shel adam kerova etzel beno kana:
Haomer leishto nechasay labbanim shetteldi mimmenni hare ellu lo yiknu kelum. shekkevan shello nitabbera bahen bishat hammattana adayin lo bau kede lihyot dato kerova lahem:

Hammakne lemin mimmine chayya lo hikna kelum. hikna ketzat nechasav livhema o lemi shello ba laolam vechazar veamar lachavero kene kivhema zo o keubbar ze lo kana kelum. amar lo kene at uvehema zo o at veebbar ze kana mechetza:
En adam makne lo bemecher velo bemattana ella davar sheyyesh bo mammash aval davar sheen bo mammash eno nikne:

Ketzad. en adam makne reach hattappuach hazze o taam haddevash hazze o en habbedolach hazze. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefichach hammakne lachavero achilat perot dekel ze o dirat bayit ze lo kana. ad sheyyakne lo guf habbayit ladur bo veguf hailan leechol perotav kemo sheyyitbaer:

Din hahekdesh vedin haaniyyim vedin hannedarim eno kedin hahedyot bikniyyato sheillu amar adam kol ma shetteled behemti yihye hekdesh levedek habbayit o yihye asur alay o ettenennu litzdaka af al pi sheeno mitkaddesh lefi sheeno baolam hare ze chayyav lekayyem devaro shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase":
Vehoil vehaddavar ken im tzivva adam keshehu shechiv mera veamar kol ma sheyyotzi ilan ze laaniyyim. o kol sechar bayit ze laaniyyim zachu bahen haaniyyim:

Yesh geonim shecholkin al davar ze veomrim sheen haaniyyim zochin ella bidvarim shehedyot kone bahen. ulefichach lo yizku bedavar shello ba laolam. veen dati nota lidvarim ellu. sheen adam metzuvve lehakenot. vehu metzuvve lekayyem devarav bitzdaka o behekdesh kemo shehu metzuvve lekayyem hanneder kemo shebbearnu baarachin:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 23:
Makne adam hagguf leferotav ben bemecher ben bemattana ben bemattenat shechiv mera. veen ze makne davar shello ba leolam shehare hagguf matzuy umakne leferot. ha lema ze dome lesocher bayit o sade lachavero shello hikna lo hagguf ella hanaat hagguf: 
Ketzad. kegon shemmachar o shennatan sade leferoteha ben lizman katzuv ben kol yeme chayyav shel mocher o shel lokeach. vehu haddin lemocher ulenoten ilan leferotav. o rachel legizzatah. o behema veshifcha levaldotehem. o eved lemaase yadav. bakkol mimkaro o mattenotav kayyamin: 
Machar avdo liknas sheim yeggach veyamut yihye kenas shel lokeach. hare ze safek lefichach lo kana. veim tafas hakkenas en motziin miyyado: 
Machar ilan laze uferotav leacher lo shiyyer mekom happerot veen laacher kelum. aval im machar ilan veshiyyer perotav leatzmo hare shiyyer mekom happerot, af al pi shello peresh legabbe atzmo beayin yafa meshayyer: 
Hammocher guf hakkarka lizman katzuv hare ze mechira. umishtammesh hallokeach bagguf kecheftzo veochel happerot kol zeman hammechira uvassof tachzor livaleha: 
Uma hefresh yesh ben hammocher karka lizman katzuv uven hammakne otah leferoteha. shehakkone leferot eno yachol leshannot tzurat hakkarka velo yivne velo yaharos. aval hakkone lizman katzuv hu bone vehores veose bechol zemanno hakkatzuv kemo sheose hakkone kinyan olam leolam: 
Uma hefresh yesh ben hammocher sade zo leferoteha uven hammocher perot sade zo lachavero. shehammocher perot hassade en lallokeach lehishtammesh besade zo kelal afillu lehikkanes ella bishat hotzaat happerot veyesh levaal hassade lehishtammesh bah kecheftzo. aval hammocher sade leferoteha en baal hassade yachol lehikkanes bah ella middaat hallokeach veyesh lallokeach lehishtammesh bah kecheftzo: 
Uma hefresh yesh ben hakkone sade zo leferoteha uven hassocher sade mechavero. shehakkone sade leferoteha yesh lo lenatah o lezarah kol zeman sheyyirtze o lehovirah. vehassocher eno chen kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan sechirut. veen hassocher rashshay lehasekir aval hakkone makne laacherim kol ma shekkana: 
Hammocher perot shovach uferot kavveret lachavero kana veen ze mocher davar shello ba laolam. lefi sheeno mocher yonim sheyyivvaldu o devash sheyyavo lakkavveret. ella hu mocher shovach leferotav o kavveret ledivshah. shehare hu kesocher ammat hammayim lachavero shehu nehene bechol ma sheyyatzud bah. kach ze hikna shovach ze leferotav kemo shemmocher ilan leferotav. vedin kullam kedin hassocher bayit mechavero kemo sheamarnu. shehu nehene bechol hanayot sheyyesh bo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Habbetzim vehaefrochin atzman sheyyesh bashshovach lo kana otam baal shovach kol zeman shello parchu. vedavar ze gezerat chachamim hi umishshum <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "lo tikkach haem al habbanim" nagu bah. lefichach harotze lehakenot efrochim uvetzim ellu lachavero. metappeach al hashshovach sheyyifrechu haimmahot veyigbehu meal haaretz veachar kach yakne otan lachavero bekinyan o al gabbe karka o bishar devarim shehammittaltelin niknin bahen: 
Hallokeach perot shovach mechavero eno yachol littol kol haggozalot sheyyivvaldu bo meatta mippene shehaimmahot borchot nimtza shehecheriv kol hashshovach ella manniach mehen kede leyashshev hashshovach: 
Vechamma manniach. im hayu bo immahot uvanot beet mechirat happerot. manniach berecha rishona sheyyolidu haimmahot kede sheyyitztavvetu haimmahot im habberecha harishona veim habbanot sheimmahem. umanniach mimma sheyyolidu habbanot shete berechot kede sheyyitztavvetu habbanot im shete habberechot sheholidu. vechol hannolad meachar shete berechot shel banot vehabberecha harishona shel immahot hare ellu shello: 
Hallokeach perot kavveret mechavero notel shelosha nechilim ze achar ze mikkan veelach notel nechil umeniach nechil kede leyashshev et hakkavveret: 
Hallokeach challot devash mechavero manniach bakkavveret shete challot kede shello yifrechu haddevorim veyelchu lahen: 
Hallokeach zetim mechavero lakotz. manniach hailan samuch laaretz shete gerofiyyot vekotzetz. lakach betulat shikma magbiah shelosha tefachim vekotzetz. saddan shel shikma shene tefachim. uvishar ilanot tefach vekotzetz. bekanim uvigfanim min happekak ulemala. bidkalim vaarazim chofer umesharesh lefi sheen gizo machlif:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 24:
Hammocher shelosha ilanot betoch sadohu vaafillu hayu shalosh netiot ketannot o shelosha badde ilan. hare yesh lallokeach karka harauy lahem. vaafillu yavshu hailanot o niktzetzu yesh lo karka harauy lahem vekana kol hailanot shebbenehem: 
Vechamma hi hakkarka harauy lahem. tachtehem uvenehem vechutza lahem kimlo haore vesallo. veze hammakom shehu melo haore vesallo en echad mishshenehem yachol lezaro ella middaat chavero: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu shelosha hailanot omdin kemo shelosha pitpute kira sheshshoftin alehen et hakkedera. shehare hen shenayim ze keneged ze vehashshelishi mechuvvan benehen umeruchak mehen. vehu sheyyihyu ben kol ilan veilan mearba ammot vead shesh esre: 
Umehechan hu moded min haikkar harachav shel ilanot. aval im lo hayu omdin katztzura hazzot. o shehayu mekoravim pachot mearba ammot o meruchakin yoter mishshesh esre amma. o shellekachan ze achar ze. o shemmachar lo shenayim betoch sadehu veechad al hammetzar. o shenayim betoch shello veechad betoch shel chavero. o shehifsik bor o ammat hammayim o reshut harabbim benehem. hare ze en lo karka. lefichach lo kana hailanot shebbenehem. veim yavash hailan o niktzatz yelech lo: 
Kol mi shekkone shelosha ilanot veyesh lo karka. im higdilu vehotziu choter yakotz kede shello yemaet hadderech al baal hassade. vechol hassarigin vehaamirim hayyotzim mehem vaafillu min hashsharashim hare hen shel baal hailanot shehare yesh lo karka: 
Hakkone shene ilanot betoch sede chavero en lo karka. lefichach im met hailan o niktzatz en lo kelum. higdilu shene hailanot vehotziu sarigim vaamirim yakotz shemma yitzmechu baaretz veyomar lammocher shelosha ilanot macharta li veyesh li karka: 
Kol haetzim shekkotzetz baal shene hailanot mehen. haole min haggezaim vehu haroe pene hachamma hare hu shel baal hailanot. vehaole min hashsharashim vehu sheeno roe pene hachamma hare hu shel baal hassade. uvidkalim en levaal haddekel min haole kelum lefi sheen lo geza: 
Hammocher karka veshiyyer ilanot hare yesh lo chatzi hakkarka kullah sheillu lo shiyyer bakkarka hare omer lo hallokeach akor ilancha. vechen im shiyyer shene hailanot bilvad yesh lo karka harauy lahem. sheillu lo shiyyer hakkarka haya hallokeach omer lo akor ilancha velech: 
Hammocher et hailanot veshiyyer et hakkarka. yesh levaal hailanot karka harauy lahem kemo shebbearnu. machar et hakkarka leechad veet hailanot leacher vehechezik ze bailanot vehechezik ze bakkarka. ze kana hailanot im chatzi hakkarka veze shehechzik bakkarka kana chatzi hakkarka bilvad: 
Haachin shechalku echad natal pardes veechad natal sede lavan. yesh levaal happardes arba ammot betoch sede lavan semuchot lesof hailanot shel pardes sheal menat ken chalku. veen tzarich lefaresh davar ze mippene shehu davar yadua: 
Hammocher sade lachavero vehayu bah dekalim veamar lo chutz middekel peloni. im dekel tov umeshubbach hu oto haddekel levaddo hu sheshshiyyer vehashshear lallokeach. veim dekel ra hu sheshshiyyer kol shekken sheshshiyyer hashshear] lo kana min haddekalim kelum: 
Machar lo sade veamar lo chutz min hailanot. im yesh bo dekalim bilvad shiyyer haddekalim. veim yesh bo gefanim bilvad shiyyer haggefanim. vechen shear hailanot. hayu bah gefanim udekalim lo shiyyer ella haggefanim. ilanot ugefanim lo shiyyer ella ilanot. vechen ilanot udekalim shiyyer ilanot shehammocher beayin yafa hu mocher. veim haddekalim shiyyer lo shiyyer ella kol dekel gavoah sheolim lo bachevel vehashshear hare hu shel lokeach. veim shear hailanot hu sheshshiyyer lo shiyyer bahem ella kol sheen haol kovsho. vechol shehaol kovsho hare hu shel lokeach uvichlal hassade nechshav: 
Haomer lachavero karka udekalim ani mocher lecha. afillu lo hayu lo dekalim im ratza liknot lo shene dekalim hare ze nikna hammikkach. veen hallokeach yachol lomar lo eni lokeach ella karka sheyyesh bo dekalim. veim amar karka bidkalim ani mocher lecha. im hayu bo shene dekalim kana veim lav mekach taut hu vechozer. veim amar lo karka shel dekalim ani mocher lecha en lo dekalim. sheen ballashon hazze ella karka harauy lidkalim: 
Hammocher pardes lachavero tzarich sheyyichtov lo kene lecha dekalim utemarim vehutzin. veaf al pi shekkana kol ellu af al pi shello peresh otam noye hashshetar hem. vechen hammocher karka lachavero tzarich lichtov lo velo hinnachti lefanay bemecher ze kelum kede lehistallek min haddinin vehatteanot: 
Hammocher bayit lachavero af al pi shekkatav lo vehikneti lecha amko verumo tzarich lichtov lo kene lecha mehakkarka hattehom ad rum rakia. shehaomek veharum eno nikne bistam. vechevan shekkana haomek veharum kana harum shehu haavir bilvad vehaomek shehu ovi haaretz. aval lo kana habbenonit shebbammaamakkim veshebbaavir. vechevan shekkatav lo mikkarka hattehom ad rum harakia kana habbor vehaddut shebboovi hakkarka vehammaazivot vehammechillot shebben hammaazivot lemala: 
Hammocher bayit lachavero al menat sheddeyota elyona shelli hare zo shello. veim ratza lehotzi bah zizin motzi. veim nafla chozer uvone otah. veim ratza livnot al gabbah bone keshehaya mikkodem: 
Hammocher kivro o derech kivro o mekom maamado o bet hespedo. bain bene mishpacha vekovrim sham beal karcho mishshum pegam mishpacha. venotnin deme hakkever shekkavru bo lallokeach af al pi shello peresh:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 25:
Hammocher davar sheyyesh lo tashmishin lo machar et hattashmishin ella im ken peresh. ketzad. machar et habbayit lo machar et hayyatzia shessevivot habbayit af al pi shehu patuach letocho. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya rochav hayyatzia arba ammot o yeter. aval pachot mizze hare hu bichlal habbayit. vechen haaliyya sheal gabbe habbayit happetucha letocho baarubba bemeazivat habbayit hare hu bichlal habbayit: 
Hammocher et habbayit lo machar et hacheder shellefanim mimmennu. af al pi shemmetzer lo metzarim hachitzonim. velo et haggag bizman sheyyesh lo maake asara tefachim veyesh bo rochav arba ammot. velo et habbor hechafur bakkarka velo et haddut habbanuy babbor af al pi shemmachar lo haomek veharum kemo shebbearnu: 
Vetzarich hammocher liknot lo derech min hallokeach kede lehikkanes bevor ze o laddut sheshshiyyer. shekkol hammocher beayin yafa mocher. veim amar lo macharti lecha habbayit chutz min habbor o haddut en tzarich liknot lo derech. vechen hammocher bor o dut bilvad en hallokeach tzarich liknot lo derech ella nichnas letoch beto shel mocher ad haddut umemalle: 
Shene battim ze lefanim mizze. machar shenehem lishnayim o natan shenehem lishnayim en lahem derech ze al ze. veen tzarich lomar im natan hachitzon umachar happenimi. aval im machar hachitzon venatan happenimi yesh lo derech shekkol hannoten beayin yafa noten yoter min hammocher: 
Hammocher et habbayit machar et hattannur veet hakkirayim veet malbenot happetachim hamechubbarin betit veet haddelet veet hanneger veet hammanul aval lo hammafteach. umachar et hammachteshet hakkevua aval lo et hammitalttelet. umachar et haitzterovil aval lo et hakkeli shehakkemach yored letocho shehu kemo kefifa shel etz. velo machar et malbenot kire hammitta velo et malbenot hachallonot af al pi shehen mechubbarin betit mippene shehen lenoy. uvizman sheamar hu vechol ma shebbetocho hare kullan mechurin: 
Hammocher et hechatzer machar borot shichin umearot shebbetochah. vechol habbattim hachitzonim vehappenimim uvattim sheyyesh bahen hachol vehachanuyyot happetuchot letochah. aval sheenan petuchot letochah enam nimkarim immah. hayu petuchot lechan ulechan im rov tashmishan letochah nimkarot immah veim lav enan nimkarot immah. velo machar et hammittaltelin shebbetochah. uvazzeman sheamar hi vechol ma shebbetochah hare kullam mechurin. ben kach uven kach lo machar et hammerchatz velo bet habbad shebbetochah: 
Hammocher et bet habbad machar et haeven haggedola habbenuya baaretz shettochanim aleha zetim. veet hakkelunsaot shel erez shessomchin bahen beet techinat hazzetim. veet hayekavim veet hakkelim shennotnin bahen et hazzetim hakketushin vehem hamefarchot. aval lo machar et harechayim haelyona. uvizman sheamar hu vechol ma shebbetocho hare kullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach lo machar et hakkovshin shemmechabbeshin bahen hazzetim velo et haggalgal velo et hakkora velo et hassakkin velo et hammartzufin: 
Amar lo bet habbad vechol tashmishav ani mocher lecha kullan mechurin. hayu chutza lah chanuyyot sheshshotchim bahen hazzetim o hashshumshemin. im metzer lo metzarim hachitzonim shellahen kana hakkol. veim lav lo kana ella ma shebbetochah: 
Hmocher et hammerchatz machar et bet hannesarim sheyyoshvin alehen keshehen arummim. veet bet hayekamim shennotlin bahen hammayim. veet bet hassafsalin sheyyoshvin alehen bachatzar hammerchatz keshehen levushim. veet bet havvilaot shemmistappegin bahen. aval lo machar et hannesarim atzman veet hayyekamim atzman velo et hassafsalin atzman velo et bet havvilaot atzman. uvizman sheamar lo hu vechol ma shebbetocho hare kullan mechurin. ben kach uven kach lo machar habberechot hamesappekot lo mayim ben bimot hachamma ben bimot haggeshamim. velo bet kinnus haetzim. veim amar lo merchatz vechol tashmishav ani mocher lecha hare hen kullan mechurin af al pi shehen chutza lo:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 26:
Hammocher et hair machar battim uvorot shichin umearot umerchatzaot veshovachot uvet habbaddim uvet hashshelachin shebbah vehassemuchin lah. veet hachorashin hammukkafin lah veet hassadot hayeduot lah. veet habbevarin shel chayya veofot vedagim sheppenehem kenegdah af al pi shehen rechokim mimmenna. aval lo machar hammittaltelin shebbetochah. uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah ani mocher lecha hare kullan mechurin. uven kach uven kach lo machar lo et sheyareha velo et benoteha velo hachorashin hammuktzin mimmenna. velo et hachelek sheyyesh lah bayyam velo et hachelek sheyyesh lah bayyabbasha. velo et bevare chayya veofot vedagim sheen penehem kenegdah: 
Hammocher et hassade machar et haavanim hassedurot laggader veet haavanim shemmunnachot al hoomarim mippene shehen letzarkah. umachar et hakkanim hachalakim hammunnachin tachat haggefanim kede lehaamid et hakkerem mippene shehen letzarkah. umachar et hattevua hamechubberet lakkarka af al pi shehiggia lehikkatzer. umachar et mechitztzat hakkanim shehi pechuta mibbet rova af al pi shehakkanim shellah avim vachazakim. umachar et hashshomera haasuya betit af al pi sheenah kevua. umachar et hecharuv sheeno murkav veet betulat hashshikma af al pi shehen avim. umachar kol haddekalim shebbah. aval lo machar et haavanim sheenan sedurot laggader. velo et haavanim sheenan munnachot al gabbe hoomarin af al pi shehen muchanot lechach. velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan munnachin tachat haggefanim af al pi shehen meshuppin vachalakim umuchanim lechach. velo et hattevua haakura min hakkarka af al pi shehi tzericha lassade. uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah hare kullan mechurin: 
Ben kach uven kach lo machar mechitztzat hakkanim shehi bet rova af al pi shehakkanim shebbah dakkim uketannim. velo machar aruga ketanna shel besamim sheyyesh lah shem bifne atzmo kegon shekkorin lah be varda shel peloni. velo et hashshomera bizman sheenah asuya betit af al pi shehi kevua baaretz. velo machar et hecharuv hammurkav. velo saddan shel shikma vaafillu hen dakkim. velo machar et habbor shebbah velo et haggat velo et hashshovach ben charevim ben shelemim: 
Vetzarich hammocher liknot lo derech min hallokeach kede sheyyelech bah ad oto habbor o oto haddut o oto haggat o oto hashshovach shennisharu lo betoch hassade. veim peresh veamar chutz meellu eno tzarich likkach lo [derech]: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemocher, mippene shehaya lo lallokeach lefaresh velo peresh en lo et ellu. aval hannoten mattana kana et kullan ben bassade ben babbayit ben bechatzer ben bevet habbad. kelalo shel davar hannoten karka bemattana kana hamekabbel kol hamechubbar lah ad sheyyefaresh: 
Vechen haachin shechalku vezacha echad mehen bassade zacha bechullan. vehammachazik benichse hagger hechezik bassade zacha bechullan. vehammakdish et hassade hikdish kullan: 
Af bemocher velokeach en kol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen meinyanim amurim ella bemakom sheen sham minhag velo shemot yeduim lechol davar vedavar bifne atzmo. aval bemakom shennahagu shehammocher kach machar kach hare ze machur vesomchin al hamminhag. vechen makom sheen korin ella bayit levayit levaddo o shekkorin bayit levayit vechol sevivotav ulechol sheal gabbav holchin achar leshon anshe hammakom. vechen haddin bemocher chatzer o sade o ir o mittaltelin bakkol holchin achar hashshemot haaruchot befi hakkol: 
Veze ikkar gadol bechol divre massa umattan holchin achar leshon bene adam beoto hammakom veachar hamminhag. aval makom sheen yadua bo minhag velo shemot meyuchadin ella yesh korin kach veyesh shekkorin kach osim kemo sheppershu chachamim bifrakim ellu:
