Mishneh Torah, Sales 27: Hammocher et hassefina machar et hattoren veet hannes veet hooganim shellah veet kol hammeshotin hammanhigin otah. veet hakkevesh vehaaskala sheolin bahen lassefina veyordin aleha. veet bet hammayim shebbetochah. aval lo machar et habbitztzit vehi hassefina hakketanna sheholchim bah al hammayim hakkerovim layyabbasha. velo machar haddugit vehi hassefina hakketanna shetztzadin bah hammallachim et haddagim. velo machar et haavadim haosin bahen. velo et hammartzufin. velo et hassechora shebbetochah. uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah ani mocher hare kullan mechurin:

Hammocher et hakkaron lo machar et happeradot bizman sheenan keshurot immo. machar et happeradot lo machar et hakkaron. machar et hatztzemed lo machar et habbakar. machar et habbakar lo machar et hatztzemed. vaafillu bemakom shekkorin miktzatan letzemed bakar:

Hammocher et haol machar et happara. machar et happara lo machar et haol. machar et haagala machar et habbakar. machar et habbakar lo machar et haagala. veen haddamim reaya bechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen:
Vechen hammocher et hachamor machar et hammirdaat veet haukkaf af al pi sheenan alav. aval lo machar et hassak velo merkevet hannashim vaafillu hayu alav bishat hammecher:

Veen haddamim reaya sheim taa bichde shehaddaat toa yesh lo onaa o bittul mikkach kedin kol hammocher velokeach. veim taa bichde sheen haddaat toa lo batal hammikkach. shezze mattana natan lo veen lo ella hachamor belo sakkim. vechen kol kayyotze baze en meviin bo reaya min haddamim:

Hammocher et hashshifcha machar kelim shealeha afillu hem mea. aval lo machar hashsherim velo hannezamim velo hattabbaot velo et hakkatlaot shebbetzavvarah. veim amar lo shifcha vechol ma shealeha hare kullan mechurin af al pi sheyyesh aleha kelim shel mea mane:

Haomer lachavero shifcha meebberet ani mocher lecha. para meebberet ani mocher lecha. machar lo et havvalad. shifcha menika ani mocher lecha. para menika ani mocher lecha. lo machar lo et havvalad. chamora menika ani mocher lecha machar lo et hasseyach sheen adam kone chamora lachalavah:

Haomer lachavero rosh eved ze o rosh chamor ze ani mocher lecha hare ze machar chetzyo. vechen haddin bechol evar shehanneshama teluya bo. amar lo yad eved ze o yad chamor ze ani mocher lecha meshammenin benehem. vechen haddin bechol evar sheen hanneshama teluya bo. amar lo rosh para zo ani mocher lecha lo machar ella harosh bilvad shehare roshah nimkeret tamid bammitbachayim:

Machar et harosh bivhema gassa lo machar et haraglayim. machar et haraglayim lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane lo machar et hakkaved. machar et hakkaved lo machar et hakkane. aval bivhema dakka machar et harosh machar et haraglayim. machar et haraglayim lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane machar et hakkaved. machar et hakkaved lo machar et hakkane:
Hammocher et habbor lo machar et memav. machar et haashpa machar et zivlah. machar kavveret machar devorim. machar shovach machar et hayyonim:

Al yaloz meenecha haikkar haggadol bidvarim ellu shehu minhag hammedina vehashshemot hayeduim beyichud lechol davar vedavar. uvemakom sheen minhag velo shem shehakkol omrim lo beyichud velo shittuf holchin achar ellu hakkelalot shebbearu chachamim kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 28: Haomer lachavero bet kor afar ani mocher lecha vehayu betoch hassadot geayot ketannim amukkim asara tefachim af al pi sheen bahen mayim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim en nimdadin bichlal habbet kor. sheen adam rotze litten meotav bemakom echad venirin kishnayim o shelosha mekomot. velokeach ellu haggeayot vehasselaim bichlal habbet kor belo damim. hayu pachot mikkan nimdadin immah:

Bamme devarim amurim keshello haya bahen ella bet arbaa kabbin vehayu haarbaa kabbin muvlain betoch chameshet kabbin umuvlain betoch rubbah shel sade. aval hayta yeter al arbaa kabbin o shehayu mefuzzarin harebe o enan muvlain. af al pi sheen bahen asara enan nimdadin immah. hayu nivlain rubban bemiutah o miutan berubbah. o shehayu muchlakin kemo chut shave o kemo iggul o kemo meshullash o shehayu batztzedadin o shehayu derech akallaton. kol ellu safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vechen im hayu afar millemala vesela millematta o sela millemala veafar millematta hare ze safek:
Haya bah sela yechidi afillu bet rova lechor en nimdad immah. veim haya samuch lammetzar afillu kol shehu en ze nimdad immah. hifsik afar ben sela lammetzar hare ze safek:
Amar lo kevet kor afar ani mocher lecha. afillu hayu bah geayot amukot asara tefachim o yoter o selaim gevohim asara tefachim o yoter hare ellu nimdadin immah:
Haomer lachavero bet kor afar ani mocher lecha midda bechevel. im pichet kol shehu menakke lo min haddamim veim hotir kol shehu yachzir lo:

Amar bet kor afar ani mocher lecha. hare ze kemi shepperesh veamar bet kor afar ben chaser ben yater. veim pichet min hammidda echad mearbaa veesrim shehu rova lechol sea o hotir kach rova lechol sea higgio. yeter al ken yachshov immo al kol harvaim kullan shechasru o hosifu. vechol sheppichet mibbet kor yenakke lo min haddamim vechol shehosif al bet kor yachzir lo:

Uma hu machzir lo. im hayta hattosefet pechuta mittisha kabbin machzir lo damim kishat hammechira leyappot koach hammocher. veim hayta hattosefet semucha lesade acheret shel mocher machzir lo otah hattosefet karka shehare somech otah lishar sedotav veeno mafsid kelum. hayta hattosefet yetera al tisha kabbin notnin rova lechol sea usea. vehannishar yeter al harvaim im yesh bo tisha kabbin noten lo kol harvaim kullan im hayyeter min hakkarka venotno lo keshaa shellekachah mimmennu:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehi bezol bishat mimkar vehokira bishat hachezarat hayyeter. aval im hayta beyoker vehuzela. omrin lallokeach im ratzita litten lo deme hattosefet kullah ten lo damim kefi hammimkar veim ratzita litten lo karka ten lo kemo sheshshave achshav:

Vedin chatzi kav beginna kedin tisha kabbin besade. sheim hotira beginna pachot mechatzi kav al harvaim eno machzir lo ella damim. hotir chatzi kav machzir lo et kol harvaim im hayyeter bedamim o karka kishat hazzol shel et hachazara:
Machar sade venaaset ginna beyad lokeach. o ginna venaaset sade. hare ze safek im mechashshev lo kedin shehayta beet hammecher o kedin shehi atta:

Haomer lachavero bet kor afar ani mocher lecha midda bechevel ben chaser ben yater. o sheamar bet kor ani mocher lecha ben chaser ben yater midda bechevel. hallech achar happachut shebballeshonot veen lo ella kaddin im chaser im yater:

Machar lo bet kor veamar lo bassimanin uvammetzarim. pichet shetut o hotir shetut higgio. pichet yeter al shetut yenakke lo min haddamim. hosif lo yeter al shetut yitten lo damim o karka hakkol lefi hashshiyyur. im hannishar bassade pachot mittisha kabbin uvagginna pachot mechatzi kav velo haya samuch lassade hammocher machzir lo haddamim:

Hammocher lachavero sade shehallokeach yodea otah veet metzareha uchevar hurgal bah. afillu amar lo yesh bimshichatah matayim venimtzet bah mea vachamishshim higgiato shehare yedaah vekibbel alav. veze shehizkir lo hachashivut, kelomar shehi yafa kemo sade acheret sheyyesh bimshichatah matayim:

Haomer lachavero bet kor peloni ani mocher lecha af al pi sheen bimshichato ella letech higgio. shello machar lo ella makom hannikra bet kor. lefichach tzarich hammocher lehavi reaya shehu nikra bet kor. vechen haomer lachavero kerem shelli bemakom peloni ani mocher lecha af al pi sheen bo gefanim higgio vehu sheyyihyu korin oto kerem. vechen haomer lachavero pardes ze ani mocher lecha. afillu en bo rimmonim higgio vehu sheyyikkare pardes. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:
Vechen kol haddevarim haellu bemakom sheen sham minhag kemo shebbearnu. aval bemakom sheyyesh minhag hallech achar hamminhag veachar leshon rov anshe hammakom hayeduim lahen:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 29: Shelosha en mikkachan mikkach veen mimkaran mimkar din tora. hacheresh hashshote vehakkatan. aval chachamim tikkenu sheyyihye hacheresh vehakkatan nose venoten umaasav kayyamin mishshum kede chayyav:

Hacheresh ketzad nose venoten. cheresh sheeno shomea velo medabber o medabber veeno shomea kelum. mocher velokeach hammittaltelin birmiza. aval lo bekarka. veaf bemittaltelin lo yitkayyemu maasav ad shebbodkin oto bedikot rabbot umityashshevin baddavar:

Illem sheshshomea veeno medabber o mi shennishtattek mikkacho mikkach umimkaro mimkar umattenotav kayyamot bakkol. ben bemittaltelin ben bekarka. vehu sheyyivdok kederech shebbodkin legittin o yichtov bichtav yado:
Hashshote en mikkacho mikkach veen mimkaro mimkar veen mattenotav kayyamot. uvet din maamidim appotroppos leshotim kederech shemmaamidin liktannim:

Mi shehu et shote veet shafuy kegon ellu hannichpin. beet shehu shafuy kol maasav kayyamin vezoche leatzmo velaacherim kechol ben daat. utzerichin haedim lachkor haddavar hetev shemma besof shetuto o bitchillat shetuto asa ma sheasa:

Katan ad shesh shanim en hakenayato laacherim kelum. umishshesh shanim ad sheyyagdil im yodea betiv massa umattan mikkacho mikkach umimkaro mimkar umattenato kayyemet. ben bedavar merubbe ben bedavar muat ben bemattenat bari ben bemattenat shechiv mera. vedavar ze middivre chachamim kemo shebbearnu kede shello yibbatel velo yimmatze mi sheyyimkor lo velo yikkach mimmennu. vehakkol bemittaltelin aval bakkarka eno mocher velo noten ad sheyyagdil:

Bamme devarim amurim bekatan sheen lo appotroppos. aval im haya lo appotroppos en maasav kelum afillu bemittaltelin ella middaat haappotroppos. sheim ratza lekayyem mikkacho umimkaro umattenato bemittaltelin kayyam:

Bodkin et hakkatan im yodea betiv massa umattan o eno yodea. lefi sheyyesh katan chacham venavon shehu yodea vehu ben sheva. veyesh acher sheafilu ben shelosh esre eno yodea betiv massa umattan. katan hayyodea betiv massa umattan sheen lo appotroppos shennasa venatan bemittaltelin vetaa dino kedin haggadol. pachot mishshetut mechila. shetut machzir hahonaya. yeter al shetut batel mikkach kemo shebbearnu. vaani omer sheen mikkach hakkatan umimkarav bemittaltelin kayyamin ella beshemmashach o himshich. aval im natan maot al hammikkach vechazar bo eno mekabbel mi sheppara vaacherim shechazru bo mekabbelin mi sheppara:

Vechen im kanu miyyad hakkatan o hiskir mekom hammittaltelin vechazar bo lo kana hallokeach sheen motziin mide hakkatan bedin veen kinyan miyyad hakkatan kelum. shehakkinyan bishtar veen haedim chotmin ella al shetar shel adam gadol:

Vechen katan shekkana mittaltelin vekanu miyyado vesachar mehem hammakom lo kana ad sheyyimshoch. lefi sheeno zoche bidrachim shezzochin bahen haggedolim. reaya laddavar sheen chatzer shel katan velo arba ammot shello konin lo mippene shennitrabbu middin shelichut velo middin yado kemo sheyyitbaer velo yihye hakkinyan o sechirut hammakom gadol mechatzero. aval hakketanna shenitrabbeta chatzerah miyyadah tikne hammittaltelin meacherim im kanu miyyadah o bischirut makom:

Yerae li shekkatan shekkana karka venatan damim vehechezik bakkarka taamod beyado af al pi sheen mimkaro bakkarka kelum shehakkatan kemi sheeno befanenu hu vezachin leadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav:

Katan shehigdil vehevi hazzachar shete searot achar shelosh esre shana vehabbat achar shetem esre af al pi sheeno yodea betiv massa umattan mikkacho mikkach umimkaro mimkar umattenato mattana bemittaltelin. aval bekarka en maasav kayyamin ad sheyyihye yodea betiv massa umattan achar shehigdil:

Bamme devarim amurim bekarka shello. aval karka sheyyarash meavotav o mishshear morishav en mimkaro mimkar ad sheyyihye ben esrim shana af al pi shehevi shete searot veyodea betiv massa umattan. shemma yimkor bezol mippene sheddato nota achar hammaot vaadayin lo nityashsheva dato bedarche haolam:

Mattenato keshehu pachot mibben esrim ben mattenat bari ben mattenat shechiv mera hare zo kayyemet. sheillu lo higgia lo hanaya gedola lo natan. vehu davar sheeno matzuy tamid. veamru chachamim titkayyem mattenato kede sheyyihyu devarav nishmain:

Bamme devarim amurim shehu mocher karka aviv keshehu ben esrim keshehevi shete searot o keshennoldu lo simane saris. aval im lo hevi shete searot velo naasa saris. katan hu veen mimkaro bakkarka mimkar vaafillu binchasav ad sheyyagdil lerov shenotav:

Mi shemmachar ben binchasav ben benichse aviv umet uvau kerovav veiraru shehaya katan bishat hammecher uvikkeshu levadko en shomin lahem lenavvelo. veod shehassimanim mishtanin bemita. vachazaka hi sheen haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken yadu bevadday shehammocher gadol:

Pachot mibben esrim shemmachar karka aviv chozer umotzi miyyad hallokeach ben kodem esrim ben achar esrim. umotzi min hallokeach kol happerot sheachal. veim hotzi hotzaot o shennata vezara shamin lo umachazir et hashshear. kaddin hazze horu rabbotay. vaani omer sheafillu katan shemmachar karka minnichse aviv ucheshennaasa ben esrim lo micha eno yachol lachzor. shekkevan shellakach hammaot venishtammesh hallokeach bekarka zo lefanav keshehu ben esrim velo micha nitkayyema bide hallokeach shehare ratza bemimkaro:

Hashshikkor mikkacho mikkach umimkaro mimkar umattenotav kayyamin. veim higgia leshichruto shel lot vehu hashshikkor sheose veeno yodea ma ose en maasav kelum vahare hu keshote o kekatan pachot mibben shesh:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 30: Hammocher shemmachar karka o mittaltelin vezacha bahen hallokeach shello middato yad hallokeach al haelyona. veim ratza lokeach en hammocher yachol lachzor bo veim lo ratza tachzor livaleha. lefichach kotvin shetar lammocher af al pi sheen hallokeach immo. uleolam hallokeach noten sechar hassofer vaafillu machar sadehu mippene raatah:

Vechen haeved shekkana o machar o natan mattana o netanah lo. yad haadon al haelyona. im ratza lekayyem maasav hare ellu kayyamin veim lo ratza batlu kol maasav. uvidvarim bilvad hu shemmekayyem haadon o mevattel veeno tzarich liknot mimmennu kelum:

Vechen haishsha shemmachra o natna mattana. ben benichse balah ben benichse tzon barzel shehichnisa lo. ben bidvarim sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah ben benichse melog. ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin. vechen im lakcha o nitna [lah mattana] yad habbaal al haelyona veim ratza lekayyem yekayyem im ratza levattel yevattel hakkol. aval habbaal shemmachar o natan ben karka shehichnisa lo ishto bichtubbatah o karka shehichnis lah shum mishshello. ben karka sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah. af al pi shekkanu miyyad haishsha achar shekkiyyema maasav hare kol ma sheasa batel mippene shehi omeret nachat ruach asiti levali:
Machar o natan nichse melog ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin yad haishsha al haelyona. ratzta levattel mevattelah veim kiyyema maaseha kanu hallakochot:

Baal shemmachar mittaltelin shel nichse tzon barzel o mittaltelin shennatna lo mishshello af al pi sheeno rashshay im avar umachar o natan kanu hallakochot veen haishsha yechola lehotzi miyyadam. vechen yesh lo labbaal limkor kol nechasav af al pi shehen tachat yad shibud hakketuva. veim tavo litrof torefet ella im ken katva lallokeach techilla vekanu miyyadah:

Haishsha shemmachra o natna nichse tzon barzel levalah lo kana. veyesh lah lachzor ulehotzi miyyado kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut. bet din shemmachru o lakchu benichse yetomim ben bekarka ben bemittaltelin. vechen haappotropposin ben shemminnu otam bet din ben shemminna otan avi yetomim. mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar aval mattenatam enah kelum sheen adam noten davar sheeno shello:

Hammocher o hannoten beshabbat veen tzarich lomar bayyom tov af al pi shemmakkin oto maasav kayyamin. vechen kol mi shekkanu miyyado beshabbat hakkinyan kayyam vechotvin leachar hashshabbat venotnin: seliku lehu hilchot mechira besad
Mishneh Torah, Sanctification of the New:
Chadshe hashshana hem chadshe hallevana shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 28 14)</small> "lat chodesh bechadsho" veneemar <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim". kach amru chachamim hera lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe bemare hannevua demut levana veamar lo kaze ree vekaddesh. vehashshanim sheanu mechashshevin hem shene hachamma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 1)</small> "shamor et chodesh haaviv": 
Vechamma yetera shenat hachamma al shenat hallevana karov meachad asar yom. lefichach kesheyyitkabbetz min hattosefet hazzot kemo sheloshim yom o pachot meat o yoter meat mosifin chodesh echad veosin otah hashshana shelosha asar chodesh vehi hannikret shana meebberet. shei efshar lihyot hashshana shenem asar chodesh vechach vechach yamim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "lechadshe hashshana". chodashim atta mone leshana veen atta mone yamim: 
Hallevana nisteret bechol chodesh veenah niret kemo shene yamim o pachot o yoter meat. kemo yom echad kodem shettidbak bashshemesh besof hachodesh uchemo yom echad achar shettidbak bashshemesh veterae bammaarav baerev. uvallayil shetterae bammaarav achar shennistera hu techillat hachodesh umonin meoto hayyom tisha veesrim yom. veim yerae hayyareach lel sheloshim yihye yom sheloshim rosh hachodesh. veim lo yerae yihye rosh hachodesh yom echad usheloshim veyihye yom sheloshim mechodesh sheavar. veen nizkakin layyareach belel echad usheloshim ben shennira ben shello nira. sheen lecha chodesh levana yoter al sheloshim yom: 
Chodesh sheyyihye tisha veesrim veyerae yareach belel sheloshim nikra chodesh chaser. veim lo yerae hayyareach veyihye hachodesh sheavar sheloshim yom nikra chodesh meubbar venikra chodesh male. veyareach sheyyerae belel sheloshim hu hannikra yareach shennira bizmanno. veim nira belel echad usheloshim velo nira belel sheloshim hu nikra yareach shennira belel ibburo: 
En reiyyat hayyareach mesura lechol adam kemo shabbat bereshit shekkol echad mone shishsha veshovet bashshevii. ella levet din haddavar masur ad sheyyekaddeshuhu bet din veyikbeu oto hayyom rosh chodesh hu sheyyihye rosh chodesh. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze lachem" edut zo tihye mesura lachem: 
Bet din mechashshevin becheshbonot kederech shemmechashshevim haitztagninim sheyyodin mekomot hakkochavim umahalacham vechokrim umedakdekim ad sheyyedu im efshar sheyyerae hayyareach bizmanno shehu lel sheloshim o i efshar. im yadu sheefshar sheyyerae yoshvin umetzappin laedim kol hayyom kullo shehu yom sheloshim. im bau edim uderashum vachakarum kahalacha veneemnu divrehem mekaddeshin oto. veim lo nira velo bau edim mashlimin sheloshim veyihye chodesh meebbar. veim yadu becheshbon shei efshar sheyyerae en yoshvim yom sheloshim veen metzappin laedim. veim bau edim yodin bevadday shehen ede sheker o shenniret lahem demut levana min heavim veenah hallevana havvaddait: 
Mitzvat ase min hattora al bet din sheyyechashshevu veyedu im yerae hayyareach o lo yerae. vesheyyidreshu et haedim ad sheyyekaddeshu et hachodesh. veyishlechu veyodiu shear haam bee ze yom hu rosh chodesh kede sheyyedu bee ze yom hen hammoadot. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 2)</small> "asher tikreu otam mikrae kodesh" veneemar <small>(Shemot 13 10)</small> "veshamarta et hachukka hazzot lemoadah": 
En mechashshevin vekovin chodashim umeabberin shanim ella beeretz yisrael shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 2 3)</small> "ki mitztziyyon tetze tora udevar Adonai mirushalayim". veim haya adam gadol bechachma venismach beeretz yisrael veyatza lechutza laaretz velo hinniach beeretz yisrael kemoto hare ze mechashshev vekovea chodashim umeabber shanim bechutza laaretz. veim noda lo shennaasa beeretz yisrael adam gadol kemoto veen tzarich lomar gadol mimmennu hare ze asur likboa uleabber bechutza laaretz veim avar vekava veibber lo asa kelum:

En kasher leedut hachodesh ella shene anashim kesherim haruyin lehaid bechol davar vedavar. aval nashim vaavadim hare hen kishar pesule edut veen meidin. av uveno sherau et hayyareach yelchu levet din lehaid. lo mippene sheedut hachodesh keshera bikrovim ella sheim yimmatze echad mehen pasul mippene shehu gazlan vechayyotze bo mishshear happaslanut yitztaref hashsheni im acher veyaidu. vechol happasul leedut middivre sofrim af al pi shehu kasher min hattora pasul leedut hachodesh:

Din tora sheen medakdekin beedut hachodesh. sheafillu kiddeshu et hachodesh al pi edim venimtzeu zommin beedut zo hare ze mekuddash. lefichach hayu barishona mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkol adam miyyisrael shekkol yisrael bechezkat kashrut ad sheyyivvada lecha shezze pasul. mishshekkilkelu habbaytosim vehayu sochrin anashim lehaid sherau vehem lo rau hitkinu shello yekabbelu bet din edut hachodesh ella meedim shemmakkirin bet din otan shehem kesherim vesheyyihyu dorshin vechokrim baedut:

Lefichach im lo yihyu bet din yodim et haedim sherau et hayyareach meshallechin anshe hair shennira bah im haedim sherau edim acherim shemmezakkin otan levet din umodiin otan sheellu kesherim hem veachar kach mekabbelin mehem:

Bet din mechashshevin badderachim shehaitztagninin mechashshevin bahem veyodin hallevana keshetterae bechodesh ze im tihye bitzfon hashshemesh o bidromah veim tihye rechava o ketzara ulehechan yihyu rashe karneha notin. uchesheyyavou haedim lehaid bodkin otam ketzad reitem otah betzafon o bedarom. lehechan hayu karneha notot. kamma hayta gevoha biriyyat enechem vechamma hayta rechava. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin lema shennoda bacheshbon mekabbelin otam veim lo nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin en mekabbelin otam:

Amru haedim reinuhu bammayim o beavim o baashashit. o sherau miktzato barakia umiktzato beavim o bammayim o baashashit en zo reiyya veen mekaddeshin al reiyya zot. amar echad reitiv gavoah beenay kemo shete komot veamar hashsheni kemo shalosh komot haya gavoah mitztarfin. amar haechad kemo shalosh komot vehashsheni omer kemo chamesh en mitztarfin. umitztaref echad mehem im sheni sheyyaid kemoto o yihye benehen koma achat:

Amru reinuhu belo kavvana vechevan shehitbonannu bo venitkavvannu liroto lehaid shuv lo reinuhu en zo edut veen mekaddeshin aleha. shemma avim nitkashsheru veniru kallevana vechalu vehalchu lahem. amru edim reinuhu beyom tisha veesrim shacharit bammizrach kodem shettaale hashshemesh ureinuhu arvit bammaarav belel sheloshim hare ellu neemanim umekaddeshin al reiyya zo shehare rauhu bizmanno. aval hariyya sheamru sherauhu beshacharit en nizkakin lah sheen anu achrain liriyyat shacharit uveyadua sheheavim hem shennitkashsheru venira lahem kilvana. vechen im rauhu bizmanno uvelel ibburo lo nira hare ellu neemanin sheen anu achrain ella liriyyat lel sheloshim bilvad:

Ketzad mekabbelin edut hachodesh. kol mi sherauy lehaid sheraa et hayyareach ba levet din. uvet din machnisim otan kullan lemakom echad veosin lahen seuddot gedolot kede sheyyihyu haam regilin lavo. vezug shebba rishon bodkin otan rishon babbedikot sheamarnu. machnisin et haggadol veshoalin oto. nimtzeu devarav mechuvvanim lacheshbon machnisim et chavero. nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanin edutan kayyemet. ushear kol hazzugot shoalin otam rashe devarim. lo shetztzerichim lahem ella kede shello yetzu befache nefesh, kede sheyyihyu regilin lavo:

Veachar kach achar shettitkayyem haedut rosh bet din omer mekuddash vechol haam onim acharav mekuddash mekuddash. veen mekaddeshin et hachodesh ella bishlosha. veen mechashshevin ella bishlosha. veen mekaddeshin ella chodesh shennire bizmanno. veen mekaddeshin ella bayyom veim kiddeshuhu ballayla eno mekuddash. vafillu rauhu bet din vechol yisrael velo amru bet din mekuddash ad shechashcha lel echad usheloshim. o shennechkeru haedim velo hispiku bet din lomar mekuddash ad shechashcha lel echad usheloshim. en mekaddeshin oto veyihye hachodesh meubbar velo yihye rosh chodesh ella yom echad usheloshim af al pi shenniret belel sheloshim. sheen hariyya kovaat ella bet din sheamru mekuddash hem shekkovin:

Rauhu bet din atzman besof yom tisha veesrim. im adayin lo yatza kochav lel sheloshim. bet din omrim mekuddash sheadayin yom hu. veim rauhu belel sheloshim achar sheyyatzu shene kochavim. lemachar moshivin shene dayyanin etzel echad mehem veyaidu hashshenayim bifne hashshelosha vikaddeshuhu hashshelosha:

Bet din shekkiddeshu et hachodesh ben shoggin ben mutin ben anusim hare ze mekuddash vechayyavin hakkol letakken hammoadot al hayyom shekkiddeshu bo. af al pi shezze yodea shettau chayyav lismoch alehem sheen haddavar masur ella lahem umi shetztzivva lishmor hammoadot hu tzivva lismoch alehem shenneemar asher tikreu otam vegomer:

Edim sherau et hachodesh im haya benehem uven makom sheyyesh bo bet din mahalach layla vayom o pachot holchin umeidin. veim haya benehen yeter al ken lo yelchu sheen edutan achar yom sheloshim moelet shekkevar nitabber hachodesh:

Edim sherau et hachodesh hare ellu holchin levet din lehaid vaafillu haya shabbat shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 23 4)</small> "asher tikreu otam bemoadam" vechol makom shenneemar moed doche et hashshabbat. lefichach en mechallelin ella al rosh chodesh nisan veal rosh chodesh tishre bilvad mippene takkanat hammoadot. uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam mechallelin al kullan mippene karban musaf shebbechol rosh chodesh vechodesh shehu doche et hashshabbat:

Keshem shemmechallelin haedim sherau et hachodesh et hashshabbat kach mechallelin immahen haedim shemmezakkin otan bevet din im lo hayu bet din makkirin et haroin. vaafillu haya ze shemmodia otan levet din ed echad hare ze holech immahen umechallel missafek shemma yimmatze acher veyitztaref immo:

Haya haed sheraa et hachodesh belel hashshabbat chole markivin oto al hachamor vaafillu bammitta. veim yesh lahen orev badderech lokchin haedim beyadan kele zayin. veim haya derech rechoka lokchim beyadam mezonot. vaafillu rauhu gadol venire lakkol lo yomru keshem sherinuhu anachnu rauhu acherim veen anu tzerichin lechallel et hashshabbat ella kol mi sheyyire hachodesh veyihye rauy lehaid veyihye beno uven hammakom shekkavua bo bet din layla vayom o pachot mitzva alav lechallel et hashshabbat velelech ulehaid:

Barishona hayu mekabbelin edut hachodesh bechol yom sheloshim. paam achat nishtahu haedim millavo ad ben haarbayim venitkalkelu bammikdash velo yadu ma yaasu im yaasu ola shel ben haarbayim shemma yavou haedim vei efshar sheyyakrivu musaf hayyom achar tamid shel ben haarbayim. amdu bet din vehitkinu shello yihyu mekabbelim edut hachodesh ella ad hammincha kede sheyyehe shahut bayyom lehakeriv musafin vetamid shel ben haarbayim veniskehem:

Veim higgia mincha velo bau edim osin tamid shel ben haarbayim. veim bau edim min hammincha ulemala nohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulemachar kodesh umakrivin musaf lemachar lefi shello hayu mekaddeshin oto achar mincha. mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay uvet dino sheyyihyu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kol hayyom kullo vaafillu bau edim yom sheloshim besof hayyom samuch lishkiat hachamma mekabbelin edutan umekaddeshin yom sheloshim bilvad:

Keshemmeabberin bet din et hachodesh mippene shello bau edim kol yom sheloshim hayu olin lemakom muchan veosin bo seudda beyom echad usheloshim shehu rosh chodesh. veen olin lesham ballayla ella banneshef kodem alot hashshemesh. veen olin lisudda zo pachot measara. veen olin lah ella befat dagan vekitnit. veochlin beet hasseudda. vezo hi seuddat mitzva shel ibbur hachodesh haamura bechol makom:

Barishona keshehayu bet din mekaddeshin et hachodesh hayu massiin massuot berashe heharim kede sheyyedu harchokim. mishshekkilkelu hakkutim shehayu massiin massuot kede lehateot et haam hitkinu sheyyehu sheluchim yotzin umodiin larabbim. usheluchim ellu enan mechallelin et yom tov velo et yom hakkippurim veen tzarich lomar shabbat sheen mechallelin et hashshabbat lekayyemo ella lekaddesho bilvad:

Al shishsha chodashim hayu sheluchim yotzin. al nisan mippene happesach. veal av mippene hattaanit. veal elul mippene rosh hashshana. kede sheyyeshvu metzappin beyom sheloshim leelul im noda lahem shekkiddeshu bet din yom sheloshim nohagim oto hayyom kodesh bilvad. veim lo noda lahem nohagim yom sheloshim kodesh veyom echad usheloshim kodesh ad sheyyavou lahem sheluche tishre. veal tishre mippene takkanat hammoadot. veal kislev mippene chanukka. veal adar mippene happurim. uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam yotzin af al iyyar mippene pesach katan:

Sheluche nisan usheluche tishre en yotzin ella beyom rosh chodesh achar shettaale hashshemesh ad sheyyishmeu mippi bet din mekuddash. veim kiddeshu bet din besof yom tisha veesrim kemo sheamarnu veshamu mippi bet din mekuddash yotzin mibbaerev. usheluche shear hashshishsha chodashim yesh lahem latzet mibbaerev achar shennira hayyareach af al pi sheadayin lo kiddeshu bet din et hachodesh hoil venire hachodesh yatzu shehare lemachar bevadday mekaddeshin oto bet din:

Kol makom shehayu hashsheluchin maggiin hayu osin et hammoadot yom tov echad kakkatuv battora. umekomot harchokim sheen hashsheluchim maggiin alehem hayu osin shene yamim mippene hassafek lefi sheenam yodim yom shekkavu bo bet din et hachodesh e ze yom hu:

Yesh mekomot shehayu maggiin alehem sheluche nisan velo hayu maggiin lahen sheluche tishre. umin haddin haya sheyyaasu pesach yom echad shehare higgiu lahen sheluchin veyadu bee ze yom nikba rosh chodesh. veyaasu yom tov shel chag hassukkot shene yamim shehare lo higgiu alehen hashsheluchin. uchede shello lachalok bammoadot hitkinu chachamim shekkol makom sheen sheluche tishre maggiin sham osin shene yamim afillu yom tov shel atzeret:
Vechamma ben sheluche nisan lishluche tishre. shene yamim. sheshsheluche tishre enan mehallechin beechad betishre mippene shehu yom tov velo baasiri bo mippene shehu yom kippur:

En hashsheluchin tzerichin lihyotan shenayim ella afillu echad neeman. velo shaliach bilvad ella afillu taggar mishshear haam shebba kedarko veamar ani shamati mippi bet din shekkiddeshu et hachodesh beyom peloni neeman umetakkenin et hammoadot al piv. sheddavar ze davar heasuy lehiggalot hu veed echad kasher neeman alav:

Bet din sheyyashvu kol yom sheloshim velo bau edim vehishkimu banneshef veibberu et hachodesh kemo shebbearnu beferek ze. veachar arbaa o chamishsha yamim bau edim rechokim veheidu sherau et hachodesh bizmanno shehu lel sheloshim. vaafillu bau besof hachodesh. meayyemin alehen iyyum gadol umatrifim otam bishelot umatrichin alehen bivdikot umedakdekin beedut umishtaddelin bet din shello yekaddeshu chodesh ze hoil veyatza shemo meubbar:

Veim amdu haedim beedutan venimtzet mechuvvenet vahare haedim anashim yeduim unevonim venechkera haedut karauy. mekaddeshin oto vechozrin umonin leoto hachodesh miyyom sheloshim hoil venire hayyareach belelo:

Veim hutzrechu bet din lehanniach chodesh ze meubbar keshehaya kodem sheyyavou haedim ellu mannichin. veze hu sheamru meabberin et hachodesh letzorech. veyesh min hachachamim haggedolim mi shecholek bedavar ze veomer leolam en meabberin et hachodesh letzorech. hoil uvau edim mekaddeshin veen meayyemin alehen:

Yerae li sheen machaloket hachachamim bedavar ze ella bishar hechodashim chutz min nisan vetishre. o beede nisan vetishre shebbau achar sheavru hargalim. shekkevar naasa ma shennaasa veavar zeman hakkarbanot uzeman hammoadot. aval im bau haedim benisan vetishre kodem chatzi hachodesh mekabbelin edutan veen meayyemin alehen kelal. sheen meayyemin al edim sheheidu al hachodesh sherauhu bizmanno kede leabbero:

Aval meayyemin al edim shennitkalkela edutan vahare haddavar note ugenay shello titkayyem haedut veyitabber hachodesh. meayyemin alehen kede shettitkayyem haedut veyitkayyem hachodesh bizmanno. vechen im bau edim lehazim et haedim sherauhu bizmanno kodem shekkiddeshuhu bet din hare ellu meayyemin al hammezimin ad shello titkayyem hahazama veyitkaddesh hachodesh bizmanno:

Shanna meubberet hi shana shemmosifin bah chodesh. veen mosifin leolam ella adar veosin otah shana shene adarin adar rishon vaadar sheni. umippene ma mosifin chodesh ze mippene zeman haaviv kede sheyyehe happesach beoto zeman shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 1)</small> "shamor et chodesh haaviv" sheyyihye chodesh ze bizman haaviv. velule hosafat hachodesh hazze happesach ba peamim bimot hachamma ufeamim bimot haggeshamim:

Al shelosha simanin meabberin et hashshana. al hattekufa veal haaviv veal perot hailan. ketzad. bet din mechashshevin veyodin im tihye tekufat nisan beshishsha asar benisan o achar zeman ze meabberin otah hashshana. veyaasu oto nisan adar sheni kede sheyyihye happesach bizman haaviv. veal siman ze somchin umeabberin veen choshshin lesiman acher:

Vechen im rau bet din sheadayin lo higgia haaviv ella adayin afel hu. velo tzamchu perot hailan sheddarkan litzmoach bizman happesach. somchin al shene simanin ellu umeabberin et hashshana. veaf al pi shehattekufa kodem leshishsha asar benisan hare hen meabberin. kede sheyyihye haaviv matzuy lehakeriv mimmennu omer hattenufa beshishsha asar benisan. uchede sheyyihyu happerot tzomchin kederech kol zeman haaviv:

Veal shalosh aratzot hayu somchin baaviv. al eretz yehuda veal ever hayyarden veal haggalil. veim higgia haaviv bishte aratzot meellu uveachat lo higgia en meabberin. veim higgia beachat mehen velo higgia bishtayim meabberin im adayin lo tzamchu perot hailan. veillu hen haddevarim shehen haikkar shemmeabberin bishvilan kede sheyyihyu hashshanim shene chamma:

Veyesh sham devarim acherim shehayu bet din meabberin bishvilan mippene hatztzorech. veellu hen. mippene hadderachim sheenan metukkanin veen haam yecholin laalot meabberin et hashshana ad sheyyippasku haggeshamim vitakkenu hadderachim. umippene haggesharim shennehersu venimtzeu hanneharot mafsikin umonin et haam umistakkenin beatzman umetim meabberin et hashshana ad sheyyetakkenu haggesharim. umippene tannure pesachim sheavdu baggeshamim veen lahem makom litzlot et pischehem meabberin et hashshana ad sheyyibbanu hattannurim veyivshu. umippene galuyyot yisrael shenneekru mimmekoman vaadayin lo higgiu lirushalayim meabberin et hashshana kede sheyyihye lahem penay lehaggia:

Aval en meabberin et hashshana lo mippene hashsheleg velo mippene hatztzinna velo mippene galuyyot yisrael sheadayin lo neekru mimmekomam. velo mippene hattuma. kegon shehayu rov hakkahal o rov hakkohanim temeim en meabberin et hashshana kede sheyyihye lahem penay littaher veyaasu betohora ella yaasu betuma. veim ibberu et hashshana mippene hattuma hare zo meubberet:

Yesh devarim sheen meabberin bishvilan kelal aval osin otan saad leshana shetztzericha ibbur mippene hattekufa o mippene haaviv uferot hailan. veellu hen. mippene haggedayim vehattelaim sheadayin lo noldu o shehen meat. vmippene haggozalot shello parchu. en meabberin bishvil ellu kede sheyyihyu haggedayim vehattelaim metzuyin lifsachim vehaggozalot metzuyin liriyya o lemi shennitchayyev bekarban haof. aval osin otan saad leshana:
Ketzad osin otan saad leshana. omrin shana zo tzericha ibbur mippene hattekufa shemmashcha o mippene haaviv uferot hailan shello higgiu veod shehaggedayim ketannim vehaggozalot rakkim:

En meabberin et hashshana ella bimzummanin lah. ketzad. yomar rosh bet din haggadol lifloni ufeloni min hassanhedrin heyu mezummanin lemakom peloni shennechashshev venire veneda im shana zo tzericha ibbur o enah tzericha. veotan shehuzmenu bilvad hen shemmeabberin otah. uvechamma meabberin otah. matchilin bishlosha dayyanin mikkelal sanhedre gedola mimmi shessamchu otan. amru shenayim lo neshev velo nire im tzericha ibbur im lav veechad amar neshev venivdok. batel yachid bemiuto. amru shenayim neshev venire veechad omer lo neshev. mosifin od shenayim min hamezummanim venosim venotnin baddavar:

Shenayim omrim tzericha ibbur ushelosha omrin enah tzericha. batlu shenayim bemiutan. shelosha omrin tzericha ibbur ushenayim omrin enah tzericha ibbur. mosifin shenayim min hamezummanin lah venosin venotnin vegomrin beshiva. im gamru kullam leabber o shello leabber osin kemo sheggamru. veim nechleku holchim achar harov ben leabber ben shello leabber. vetzarich sheyyehe rosh bet din haggadol shehu rosh yeshiva shel echad veshivim mikkelal hashshiva. veim gamru bishlosha leabber hare zo meubberet vehu sheyyehe hannasi immahen o sheyyirtze. uveibbur hashshana matchilin min hatztzad. ulekiddush hachodesh matchilin min haggadol:

En moshivin leibbur hashshana lo melech velo kohen gadol. melech mippene chelotav umilchamotav shemma dato nota bishvilan leabber o shello leabber. vechohen gadol mippene hatztzinna shemma lo tihye dato nota leabber kede shello yavo tishre bime hakkor vehu tovel beyom hakkippurim chamesh tevilot:

Haya rosh bet din haggadol vehu hannikra nasi bederech rechoka en meabberin otah ella al tenay im yirtze hannasi. ba veratza hare zo meubberet. lo ratza enah meubberet. veen meabberin et hashshana ella beeretz yehuda shehashshechina betochah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 5)</small> "leshichno tidreshu". veim ibberuha baggalil meubberet. veen meabberin ella bayyom. veim ibberuha ballayla enah meubberet:

Yesh levet din lechashshev velikboa veleda e zo shana tihye meubberet bechol et sheyyirtze afillu lechamma shanim. aval en omrin shana pelonit meubberet ella achar rosh hashshana hu sheomer shana zo meubberet. vedavar ze mippene haddechak aval shello bishat haddechak en modiin shehi meubberet ella baadar hu sheomer shana zo meubberet vechodesh habba eno nisan ella adar sheni. amru lifne rosh hashshana shana zo shettikkanes meubberet enah meubberet baamira zo:

Higgia yom sheloshim baadar velo ibberu adayin hashshana lo yeabberu otah kelal. sheoto hayyom rauy lihyot rosh chodesh nisan umishsheyyikkanes nisan velo ibberu enan yecholim leabber. veim ibberuha beyom sheloshim shel adar hare zo meubberet. bau edim achar sheibberu veheidu al hayyareach hare ellu mekaddeshin et hachodesh beyom sheloshim veyihye rosh chodesh adar sheni. veillu kiddeshuhu kodem sheyyeabberu et hashshana shuv lo hayu meabberin sheen meabberin benisan:

En meabberin et hashshana bishnat reavon shehakkol ratzim levayit haggeranot leechol velichyot vei efshar lehosif lahen zeman leesor hechadash. veen meabberin bishviit sheyyad hakkol sholetet al hassefichin velo yimtzeu lekkarev haomer ushete hallechem. uregilin hayu leabber beerev sheviit:

Yerae li shezze sheamru chachamim en meabberin bishnat reavon uvishviit. shello yeabberu bahem mippene tzorech hadderachim vehaggesharim vechayyotze bahem. aval im hayta hashshana reuya lehitabber mippene hattekufa o mippene haaviv uferot hailan meabberin leolam bechol zeman:

Keshemmeabberin bet din et hashshana kotvin iggerot lechol hammekomot harchokim umodiim otan sheibberuha umippene ma ibberu. veal leshon hannasi nichtavot. veomer lahen yodea lachem shehiskamti ani vachaveray vehosafnu al shana zo kach vechach. ratzu tisha veesrim yom ratzu sheloshim yom. shechodesh haibbur harshut levet din lehosifo male o chaser laanashim harchokim shemmodiin otam. aval hem lefi hariyya hem osim im male im chaser:

Kol ma sheamarnu mikkeviot rosh chodesh al hariyya veibbur hashshana mippene hazzeman o mippene hatztzorech. en osin oto ella sanhedrin shebbeeretz yisrael o bet din hassemuchim beeretz yisrael shennatnu lahen hassanhedrin reshut. shekkach neemar lemoshe uleaharon <small>(Shemot 12 2)</small> "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim" umippi hashshemua lamdu ish meish mimmoshe rabbenu shekkach hu perush haddavar edut zo tihye mesura lachem ulechol haomed acharechem bimkomchem. aval bizman sheen sham sanhedrin beeretz yisrael en kovin chodashim veen meabberin shanim ella becheshbon ze sheanu mechashshevin bo hayyom: 
Vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay hu. shebbizman sheyyesh sanhedrin kovin al pi hariyya uvizman sheen sham sanhedrin kovin al pi hacheshbon hazze sheanu mechashshevin bo hayyom veen nizkakin liriyya. ella peamim sheyyihye yom shekkovin bo becheshbon ze hu yom hariyya o kodem lo bayyom o acharav bayyom. veze sheyyihye achar hariyya beyom pele hu uvaaratzot shehen lemaarav eretz yisrael: 
Umeematay hitchilu kol yisrael lechashshev becheshbon ze. missof chachme haggemara beet shecharva eretz yisrael velo nishar sham bet din kavua. aval bime chachme mishna vechen bime chachme haggemara ad yeme abbayye verava al keviat eretz yisrael hayu somchin: 
Keshehayta sanhedrin kayyemet vehen kovin al hariyya. hayu bene eretz yisrael vechol hammekomot shemmaggiin alehen sheluche tishre osin yamim tovim yom echad bilvad. ushear hammekomot harchokot sheen sheluche tishre maggiin alehem hayu osim shene yamim missafek lefi shello hayu yodin yom shekkavu bo bene eretz yisrael et hachodesh: 
Bazzeman hazze sheen sham sanhedrin uvet din shel eretz yisrael kovin al cheshbon ze. haya min haddin sheyyihyu bechol hammekomot osin yom tov echad bilvad afillu hammekomot harchokot shebbechutza laaretz kemo bene eretz yisrael. shehakkol al cheshbon echad somchin vekovin. aval takkanat chachamim hu sheyyizzaharu beminhag avotehem shebbidehem: 
Lefichach kol makom shello hayu sheluche tishre maggiin elav keshehayu hashsheluchin yotzin. yaasu shene yamim vaafillu bazzeman hazze kemo shehayu osin bizman shebbene eretz yisrael kovin al hariyya. uvene eretz yisrael bazzeman hazze osin yom echad keminhagan shemmeolam lo asu shene yamim. nimtza yom tov sheni sheanu osin begaluyyot bazzeman hazze middivre sofrim shettikkenu davar ze: 
Yom tov shel rosh hashshana bizman shehayu kovin al hariyya hayu rov bene eretz yisrael osin oto shene yamim missafek. lefi shello hayu yodin yom shekkavu bo bet din et hachodesh sheen hashsheluchin yotzin beyom tov: 
Velo od ella afillu birushalayim atzmah shehu mekom bet din peamim rabbot hayu osin yom tov shel rosh hashshana shene yamim. sheim lo bau haedim kol yom sheloshim nohagin hayu beoto hayyom shemmetzappin leedim kodesh ulemachar kodesh. vehoil vehayu osin oto shene yamim vaafillu bizman hariyya hitkinu sheyyihyu osin afillu bene eretz yisrael oto tamid shene yamim bazzeman hazze shekkovin al hacheshbon. hinne lamadta sheafillu yom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana bazzeman hazze middivre sofrim: 
En asiyyat yom tov echad teluya bikrivat hammakom. ketzad. im yihye makom beno uven yerushalayim mahalach chamishsha yamim o pachot shebbevadday efshar sheyyaggiu lahen sheluchin. en omrin sheanshe makom ze osin yom tov echad. shemmi yomar lanu shehayu hashsheluchim yotzin lemakom ze. shemma lo hayu hashsheluchim yotzin lemakom ze mippene shello hayu sham yisrael veachar shechazru likboa al hacheshbon yashvu sham yisreelim shehen chayyavin laasot shene yamim. o mippene shehaya cherum badderech kederech shehaya ben yehuda vegalil bime chachme hammishna. o mippene shehayu hakkutim monin et hashsheluchin laavor benehen: 
Veillu haya haddavar taluy bikrivat hammakom hayu kol bene mitzrayim osin yom echad. shehare efshar sheyyaggiu lahem sheluche tishre. sheen ben yerushalayim umitzrayim al derech ashkelon ella mahalach shemona yamim o pachot vechen rov sureya. ha lamadta sheen haddavar taluy bihyot hammakom karov: 
Nimtza ikkar davar ze al derech zo kach hu. kol makom sheyyesh beno uven yerushalayim mahalach yeter al asara yamim gemurim osin shene yamim leolam keminhagam mikkodem. sheen sheluche kol tishre vetishre maggiin ella lemakom shebbeno uven yerushalayim mahalach asara yamim o pachot. vechol makom shebbeno leven yerushalayim mahalach asara yamim beshave o pachot sheefshar sheyyihyu sheluchin maggiin elav. roim im oto hammakom meeretz yisrael shehayu bah yisrael bishat hariyya bechibbush sheni kegon usha ushefaram veluz veyavne venov uteverya vechayyotze bahen osin yom echad bilvad. veim oto hammakom missureya kegon tzor vedammesek veashkelon vechayyotze bahen. o michutza laaretz kegon mitzrayim veammon umoav vechayyotze bahen. osin keminhag avotehen shebbidehen im yom echad yom echad veim shene yamim shene yamim: 
Makom shebbeno uven yerushalayim asara yamim o pachot measara vehu sureya o chutza laaretz veen lahem minhag. o shehi ir shennitchaddesha bemidbar eretz yisrael. o makom sheshshachnu bo yisrael atta. osin shene yamim keminhag rov haolam. vechol yom tov sheni middivre sofrim vaafillu yom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana shehakkol osin oto bazzeman hazze: 
Ze sheanu mechashshevin bazzeman hazze kol echad veechad beiro veomrin sherosh chodesh yom peloni veyom tov beyom peloni. lo bacheshbon shellanu anu kovin velo alav anu somchin. sheen meabberin shanim vekovin chodashim bechutza laaretz. veen anu somchin ella al cheshbon bene eretz yisrael ukeviatam. veze sheanu mechashshevin legallot haddavar bilvad hu. kevan sheanu yodin sheal cheshbon ze hen somchin anu mechashshevin leda yom shekkavu bo bene eretz yisrael e ze yom hu. ukeviat bene eretz yisrael oto hu sheyyihye rosh chodesh o yom tov. lo mippene cheshbon sheanu mechashshevin:
